title: Regenerative effects of myogenic gene transfected MSC derived exosomes on radiation esophagitis.
injury_model: radiation-induced oesophageal muscle injury/fibrosis (10 Gy × 2 fractions, localized oesophageal irradiation)
ev_source: human bone-marrow MSC transfected with myogenic genes MyoD + Myogenin + Myf6 ('Myo-MIX'); naive MSC-exo and vector-exo controls
route_schedule: intramuscular injection into the oesophageal muscle layer, one day after the second irradiation (single administration)
cargo_implicated: MyoD / Myogenin / Myf6 transcripts and myogenic protein cargo (Myo-MIX transfection); specific EV cargo not quantified
mechanism_chain: Myo-MIX MSC-exo → myogenic gene expression in irradiated oesophageal muscle (Mrf4 +, Myf5 +, Myogenin +)
Myo-MIX MSC-exo → collagen deposition / fibrosis (−)
Myo-MIX MSC-exo → CD68+ macrophage infiltration (−)
Myo-MIX MSC-exo → Calponin (+), α-SMA (+) muscularis mucosae regeneration

causal_test.what: comparison with naive MSC-exo and vector-exo only; no cargo knockdown or pathway inhibitor

limitation_zh: 辐射模型但靶器官为食管（平滑肌为主+部分横纹肌），非四肢骨骼肌；未报告EV剂量、颗粒数与功能学（力学）指标。
limitation_en: Radiation model, but the target is oesophageal muscle (largely smooth muscle with some striated) rather than limb skeletal muscle; EV dose/particle number and functional (force) outcomes are not reported.
notes: Closest available in vivo radiation + EV-intervention + muscle study. Graded A for radiation relevance but note the tissue is oesophageal.

title: Irradiation of muscle precursor cells impairs the proliferative and angiogenic functions of their extracellular vesicles.
injury_model: radiation (10 Gy X-ray, muscle precursor cells in vitro; irradiated MPC + HUVEC/microvascular fragment assays)
species: rat MPC (donor/recipient); human HUVEC; rat microvascular fragments
ev_source: muscle precursor cells (MPC), non-irradiated (NoRad-EV) vs irradiated (Rad-EV)
dose: 25 µg or 50 µg total EV protein per well (MPC assays); 25 µg (low) / 75 µg (high) for HUVEC; 25 µg on d1,2,4 for MVF gels
route_schedule: in vitro addition to culture immediately after 10 Gy irradiation; repeated dosing for 3D MVF gels
mechanism_chain: NoRad MPC-EV → irradiated MPC viability (+) (52±5.7% → 71±4.9% of non-irradiated control)
NoRad MPC-EV → irradiated MPC proliferation (+) (~16% BrdU increase at 72 h)
NoRad MPC-EV → HUVEC tube branching length (+) (~1.5-fold vs Rad-EV)
NoRad MPC-EV → microvascular fragment vessel density (+) (~3-fold vs Rad-EV at day 7)
irradiation of MPC → EV miRNA cargo shift (13 down / 7 up, |FC|≥1.3) → predicted VEGFA-VEGFR2 / PI3K-Akt / SIRT1-FoxO target pathways (bioinformatic only)

causal_test.what: no cargo knockdown, no pathway inhibitor, no EV-depletion rescue; miRNA-pathway link is target prediction only

limitation_zh: 仅体外：无在体辐射肌肉模型，miRNA-通路关联仅为生物信息学预测，未做靶点验证。
limitation_en: In vitro only: no in vivo irradiated-muscle model, and the miRNA-pathway link is bioinformatic prediction without target validation.
notes: The only study found in which EVs are applied as an intervention to irradiated myogenic cells. Direct radiation relevance; no in vivo arm.

title: PTGFRN- and IL-4-overexpressing exosome-functionalized Janus fibrous scaffolds for enhanced heterogeneous tissue regeneration.
injury_model: muscle injury combined with calvarial and mandibular bone defects (heterogeneous tissue repair)
ev_source: macrophage-derived exosomes overexpressing PTGFRN and IL-4, on a Janus electrospun nanofibrous scaffold
mechanism_chain: ExoPTGFRN/IL-4 → macrophage targeting and reprogramming (M2 +) → fibrosis regulated, angiogenesis (+)
→ myogenic differentiation (+) and osteogenic differentiation (+), osteoclastogenesis (−) → soft tissue repair and bone regeneration (+)

causal_test.what: no cargo knockdown

limitation_zh: 支架、PTGFRN与IL-4三者效应难分离；肌肉终点以组织学为主，剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Scaffold, PTGFRN and IL-4 effects are hard to separate; muscle endpoints are mainly histological and dose is unreported.

title: Efficacy of neonatal mouse muscle extracellular vesicles in skeletal muscle repair and regeneration.
injury_model: glycerol-induced injury of tibialis anterior
ev_source: neonatal mouse skeletal muscle tissue (NMM-EV, Pax7+ progenitor-enriched cargo)
dose: in vitro 5 or 50 µg/µL; in vivo intramuscular dose not separately stated
timepoints: 24 and 48 h in vitro; regeneration timecourse in vivo
cargo_implicated: cargo from Pax7+ myogenic progenitors (not resolved to one molecule)
mechanism_chain: NMM-EV → satellite cell proliferation (+) and myogenic differentiation (+) (Pax7 +, MRFs +)
NMM-EV → regenerated fibre CSA (+), muscle mass (+)
NMM-EV → fibrosis (−), fat infiltration (−)

causal_test.what: no cargo knockdown; effect attributed to bulk EV

limitation_zh: 有效货物未鉴定；在体剂量描述不完整。
limitation_en: The active cargo is not identified and the in vivo dose is incompletely reported.

title: Skeletal Muscle-Derived Extracellular Vesicles During Eccentric and Concentric Exercise Promote Muscle Regeneration After Injury.
injury_model: BaCl2 (1.2%) injury of tibialis anterior, with eccentric vs concentric exercise
ev_source: skeletal muscle of sedentary (SED), concentric-exercised (CE) or eccentric-exercised (EE) mice
dose: 25 µg mEV protein per muscle in vivo; 20 µg/mL in vitro
route_schedule: intramuscular; GW4869 1 µg per TA every other day for 14 days as EV-blockade arm
cargo_implicated: lipid metabolites enriched in EE-mEV (LC-MS); AMPK energy-sensing pathway (RNA-seq inference)
mechanism_chain: eccentric exercise → muscle EV release (+) (Rab27a/b +) → muscle repair (+)
EE-mEV → Myod (+), Myog (+), eMyhc (+) → regeneration (+); fibrosis (−)
EE-mEV lipid metabolites → AMPK pathway (+) (inferred)

causal_test.what: GW4869 blockade of endogenous EV secretion abolishes the regenerative benefit of exercise

limitation_zh: AMPK机制为转录组推断，未用AMPK抑制剂验证；GW4869非EV特异。
limitation_en: The AMPK mechanism is inferred from transcriptomics without an AMPK inhibitor, and GW4869 is not EV-specific.

title: Myogenic differentiation-derived small extracellular vesicles as a therapeutic strategy for miR-193b-3p-mediated muscle regeneration.
injury_model: volumetric muscle loss (VML) of tibialis anterior
species: mouse (C57BL/6); human skeletal muscle progenitor cells
ev_source: human myoblasts during myogenic differentiation (sEV-ND / -ED / -LD by differentiation stage)
dose: 100 µg sEV in 10 µL PBS on a collagen sponge implanted into the VML defect; 50-100 µg/mL in vitro
route_schedule: local implantation in collagen scaffold at the VML site; parallel intramuscular synthetic miR-193b-3p arm
cargo_implicated: miR-193b-3p (accumulates in sEV in a differentiation-stage-dependent way)
mechanism_chain: differentiation-stage sEV miR-193b-3p → AP2M1 (−) → myogenic progression (+) → histological recovery after VML (+)
AP2M1 up-regulated in aged/sarcopenic muscle datasets (association only)

causal_test.what: AP2M1 knockdown phenocopies; synthetic miR-193b-3p delivery reproduces the effect

limitation_zh: 仅14天单一时点与组织学终点，无力学恢复数据。
limitation_en: Single 14-day timepoint with histology only; no functional force recovery data.

title: Comparative Effects of Hypoxic vs. Normoxic Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles on Tissue Repair Following Volumetric Muscle Loss (VML).
injury_model: volumetric muscle loss (≈20% of gastrocnemius-soleus removed by 3 mm punch)
ev_source: MSC cultured under normoxia (Norm-EV) vs hypoxia 3% O2 (Hypo-EV), in fibrin hydrogel
isolation_method: not fully specified (EV markers CD81/ICAM/FLOT1 assayed)
dose: 4.48 × 10^10 particles/mL encapsulated in fibrin hydrogel
cargo_implicated: EV surface markers CD81/ICAM/FLOT1 (reduced by hypoxia); no cargo effector identified
mechanism_chain: Norm-EV → muscle mass (+), angiogenesis (+), myofibre regeneration (+) vs Hypo-EV
both Norm-EV and Hypo-EV → macrophage infiltration (−) vs hydrogel alone
hypoxic preconditioning → EV yield (+1.5×) but regenerative potency (−)

causal_test.what: comparative preconditioning design only

limitation_zh: 预印本（bioRxiv），未经同行评议；仅单一14天时点，无功能学指标。
limitation_en: Preprint (bioRxiv), not peer reviewed; single day-14 timepoint and no functional endpoint.
notes: Useful negative/contrarian result on hypoxic preconditioning, which most other papers report as beneficial.

title: Platelet-Derived Extracellular Vesicle - Rich Plasma Demonstrates Favorable Histological Features Compared With PRP in a Rabbit Skeletal Muscle Injury Model.
injury_model: standardised partial muscle injury (5 × 5 mm) of biceps femoris
ev_source: platelet-derived EV-rich plasma (Exomine); Arthrex ACP and T-LAB PRP comparators
route_schedule: local administration on postoperative days 0, 4 and 7
mechanism_chain: pEV-rich plasma → neutrophil infiltration (−) and multinucleated giant cells (−) at week 3
pEV-rich plasma → lymphocyte-macrophage infiltration (−) and fibrosis (−) at week 6
conventional PRP ≈ control
limitation_zh: 仅组织病理学终点，无功能学数据；EV制剂未定量表征。
limitation_en: Histopathology only with no functional data, and the EV preparation is not quantitatively characterised.

title: Transcatheter Intra-Arterial Delivery of a Platelet-Derived Extracellular Vesicle-Enriched Preparation for Attenuating Skeletal Muscle Ischaemia-Reperfusion Injury in a Rodent Forelimb Model.
injury_model: extremity ischemia-reperfusion injury (forelimb, catheter-directed regional limb infusion)
ev_source: platelet-derived EV-enriched preparation (pEV)
route_schedule: transcatheter intra-arterial regional limb infusion just before reperfusion
mechanism_chain: pEV (regional intra-arterial) → EV retention in limb skeletal muscle (+)
pEV → local and systemic pro-inflammatory cytokines (−) → histologic myofibre injury (−); metabolic derangement (−)
limitation_zh: 新型给药途径研究，终点以早期损伤标志为主，无长期再生/纤维化数据。
limitation_en: A delivery-route study: endpoints are early injury markers, with no long-term regeneration or fibrosis data.

title: Multimodal Programming of Extracellular Vesicles via Nano-Primed SECCS-Based 3D Microenvironments for Coordinated Ferroptosis Suppression and Myogenic Regeneration in Diabetes.
injury_model: diabetic (glucolipotoxicity) skeletal muscle atrophy with ferroptotic injury
ev_source: BMSC EVs produced in fullerol-primed SECCS 3D culture (F-SECCS-EV) vs 2D-EV
isolation_method: 3D SECCS culture platform; isolation not fully specified
cargo_implicated: not resolved; fullerol priming alters cargo
mechanism_chain: F-SECCS-EV → FOXO3 (antioxidant-myogenic mediator) → ferroptotic injury (−) → myoblast proliferation and differentiation (+)
F-SECCS-EV → motor function (+), muscle strength (+), myofibre CSA (+), myogenic markers (+), macrophage polarisation modulated

causal_test.what: transcriptomic plus functional experiments identify FOXO3; multiple EV-production comparison arms

limitation_zh: 多因素（富勒醇+3D培养+EV）叠加，难以归因；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Multiple interventions are stacked (fullerol + 3D culture + EV), making attribution difficult; dose not reported.

title: Human plasma extracellular vesicles as an exercise mimetic to preserve skeletal muscle plasticity during disuse.
injury_model: 14-day hindlimb unloading (disuse) plus 7-day reloading
ev_source: human plasma EVs before (EV) and immediately after 6-week training (ExerV)
dose: 3 × 10^8 particles per injection, 4 injections
route_schedule: intraperitoneal during 14 days of hindlimb unloading
timepoints: immediately after HU and 7 days after HU
mechanism_chain: ExerV → collagen I (−) during unloading [muscle mass, fCSA and protein synthesis NOT preserved]
ExerV during reloading → Type I fibre CSA (+), capillary quantity (+), collagen (−)
limitation_zh: 重要的部分阴性结果：失用期并未保住肌量/纤维横截面积，仅在再负荷期显效。
limitation_en: An important partially negative result: muscle mass and fibre CSA were not preserved during disuse, with benefit only in the reloading phase.
notes: Useful for calibrating expectations about EVs in disuse atrophy.

title: Neonatal muscle-derived extracellular vesicles containing miR-542-3p rejuvenate aged skeletal muscle via a functional microneedle patch.
injury_model: skeletal muscle ageing (aged mice) and palmitic-acid-induced senescence in C2C12
ev_source: neonatal mouse muscle EVs (NMEV), delivered by bilayer microneedle patch (NMEVs@PLGA@Fucoidan-HA MN)
dose: 0, 50, 100, 200 µg/mL in vitro; microneedle-delivered in vivo
mechanism_chain: NMEV miR-542-3p → Asxl2-PPARγ (−) → lipid accumulation (−)
NMEV miR-542-3p → Eef1a1 (−) → AMPK pathway (+) → mitochondrial function (+), cellular senescence (−)
NMEV → muscle ageing (−), fibrosis (−), lipid deposition (−)

causal_test.what: miR-542-3p mimic/inhibitor plus Asxl2 and Eef1a1 overexpression constructs

limitation_zh: 在体剂量未明确；微针递送效率未定量。
limitation_en: In vivo dose is not stated and microneedle delivery efficiency is not quantified.

title: Fetal muscle stem cell-derived exosomes improve dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy at the single muscle fiber level.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy, analysed at the single-fibre level
ev_source: fetal muscle stem cells (FMSC-Exos)
mechanism_chain: FMSC-Exo → MuRF1 (−) and MAFbx/atrogin-1 (−) at mRNA and protein level → single-fibre diameter (+), muscle mass (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；未探讨上游机制，体重仅趋势改善。
limitation_en: Dose not reported, no upstream mechanism, and body weight showed only a trend.

title: [Exosomes in acupoint area involved in the effect of electroacupuncture on muscle regeneration and repair in rats with multifidus muscle injury].
injury_model: bupivacaine-induced lumbar multifidus muscle injury with electroacupuncture
ev_source: endogenous acupoint-area and serum exosomes (not administered; release blocked by GW4869)
dose: GW4869 3 mg/mL, 50 µL per acupoint
route_schedule: electroacupuncture at BL40 and BL23, 2/10 Hz, 1 mA, 20 min daily for 7 days; GW4869 1 h before each session
mechanism_chain: electroacupuncture → acupoint-area exosome release (+) → Pax7 (+), MyoD (+), MyoG (+), MyHC (+) → multifidus regeneration (+), collagen (−)
GW4869 at the acupoints → exosome release (−) → all regenerative markers (−)

causal_test.what: GW4869 blockade of local exosome release reverses the electroacupuncture benefit

limitation_zh: 为内源EV依赖性验证而非外源EV治疗；GW4869非EV特异（也抑制中性鞘磷脂酶）。
limitation_en: This tests dependence on endogenous EVs rather than exogenous EV therapy, and GW4869 is not EV-specific (it also inhibits neutral sphingomyelinase).
notes: Included as an EV-dependency (loss-of-function) study, not an EV administration study.

title: Dual-targeted hybrid nanovesicles coordinated bone-muscle regeneration via regulating the DUSP4/p38 MAPK pathway to reverse osteosarcopenia.
injury_model: disuse-induced osteosarcopenia (concurrent osteoporosis and sarcopenia)
ev_source: hybrid nanovesicles fusing iPSC-MSC EVs with bone-muscle dual-targeting peptide-modified liposomes, loaded with miR-206-5p (miR@DT/iMNV)
isolation_method: membrane fusion of EV and liposome
mechanism_chain: miR@DT/iMNV miR-206-5p → DUSP4 (−) → p38 MAPK phosphorylation (+) → osteogenic and myogenic differentiation (+)
→ macrophage phenotype modulated, mitochondrial function restored → bone and muscle mass (+)

causal_test.what: DUSP4 as validated miR-206-5p target; hybrid vs plain vesicle comparison

limitation_zh: 杂合囊泡并非纯EV；剂量未报告；激活p38 MAPK的长期后果未评估。
limitation_en: Hybrid nanovesicles are not pure EVs, dose is unreported, and the long-term consequences of activating p38 MAPK are not assessed.

title: Canine Adipose MSC-Derived Exosomes Ameliorate Skeletal Muscle Injury in Mice.
injury_model: glycerol-induced mouse skeletal muscle injury (plus dexamethasone C2C12 atrophy)
ev_source: canine adipose MSC exosomes (cADMSC-Exos)
dose: 100 µg total protein (≈2.55 × 10^9 particles) in vivo; 50 µg/mL optimal in vitro (0-200 µg/mL dose-response)
route_schedule: intramuscular co-treatment with glycerol in the left TA (right TA PBS control)
mechanism_chain: cADMSC-Exo → MuRF1 (−), Atrogin-1 (−) → myotube and myofibre atrophy (−)
cADMSC-Exo → fibrosis (−) and fatty infiltration (−) in injured muscle

causal_test.what: dose-response only, no cargo or pathway arm

limitation_zh: 单一7天时点、无功能学终点；犬源EV用于小鼠为异种给药。
limitation_en: Single day-7 timepoint with no functional endpoint, and canine EVs in mice is a xenogeneic administration.
notes: One of the few papers reporting both µg and particle number for the in vivo dose.

title: Combined photobiomodulation and exosome therapy for muscle and tendon regeneration: an experimental rabbit study.
injury_model: partial Achilles tendon injury with gastrocnemius involvement
ev_source: adipose-derived MSC exosomes, with or without low-level laser therapy (830 nm, 15 mW, 3 J/cm²)
dose: 200 µg/mL exosome injection
mechanism_chain: ADSC-exo + LLLT → organised collagen and ECM (+), inflammation (−) → muscle atrophy (−)
→ tendon and gastrocnemius thickness strain (+), flexion/dorsiflexion force (+)
limitation_zh: 主要为肌腱模型，肌肉终点为次要；n=3/组，LLLT与EV的贡献未分离。
limitation_en: Primarily a tendon model with muscle as a secondary endpoint; n=3 per group and LLLT vs EV contributions are not separated.
notes: Borderline: included because gastrocnemius atrophy and strain are reported outcomes.

title: Adipocyte-Derived Exosomal Circ_0000002 Affects the Myoblast Growth and Muscle Regeneration.
injury_model: cardiotoxin-induced tibialis anterior injury; adipocyte exosomes impair regeneration
ev_source: mature adipocyte exosomes (pathogenic, sheep)
isolation_method: not fully reported (30-150 nm; TSG101, CD63, CD9)
mechanism_chain: adipocyte exosomal circ_0000002 → miR-27a sponging (−) → MSTN de-repression (+) → myoblast differentiation (−), proliferation (+)
adipocyte exosomes in vivo → muscle regeneration (−), MSTN (+)

causal_test.what: dual-luciferase for circ_0000002-miR-27a and miR-27a-MSTN; co-transfection rescue

limitation_zh: EV为致病介质；跨物种（绵羊EV注入小鼠）；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: EVs act as a pathogenic mediator, the design is cross-species (sheep EVs into mice), and dose is unreported.
notes: Negative control for the fat-muscle axis; MSTN is the convergence node.

title: Arachidonic acid triggers spermidine synthase secretion from primary tumor to induce skeletal muscle weakness upon irradiation.
injury_model: radiotherapy-associated skeletal muscle weakness/fibrosis (tumour-bearing mice receiving irradiation)
ev_source: small EVs from irradiated primary tumour cells (pathogenic, not therapeutic)
route_schedule: endogenous tumour-derived circulating sEVs; losartan given as blocking intervention
mechanism_chain: irradiation → arachidonic acid accumulation → SRM ISGylation → SRM packaging into tumour sEVs (+)
circulating SRM-sEV → skeletal muscle spermidine (+) → eIF5A-dependent type I collagen biosynthesis (+) → muscle fibrosis/weakness (+)
losartan → SRM ISGylation (−) → muscle weakness (−)

causal_test.what: losartan blockade of SRM ISGylation/secretion; eIF5A dependence

limitation_zh: EV为致病介质而非治疗性干预；未直接检测EV剂量-效应，肿瘤背景可能混杂。
limitation_en: EVs act as a pathogenic mediator rather than a therapeutic intervention; no EV dose-response, and the tumour background is a confounder.
notes: Radiation-context mechanism (tumour→muscle EV axis). Included because it defines a radiation-specific EV pathway worth mapping, not as an EV therapy.

title: miRNA-125b-5p-rich exosomes derived from fibro-adipogenic progenitors promoting muscle regeneration through inducing pro-regenerative macrophages.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury of tibialis anterior
ev_source: fibro-adipogenic progenitors (FAP) isolated at day 10 post-injury (FAPD10-exo)
dose: 1.0 × 10^7 exosomes per TA in vivo; 1.0 × 10^7 exosomes/well in vitro
timepoints: 3, 7, 10 days post-injury (donor FAP); readouts at day 4 and day 7
mechanism_chain: FAPD10-exo miR-125b-5p → PTPN1 (−) → ERK pathway (−) → macrophage M2 polarisation (+) (CD206 +)
M2 macrophages → MuSC activation (+) → eMyHC (+1.5× d4, +1.6× d7)
FAPD10-exo → fibrotic area (−~15% at d4 and d7)

causal_test.what: RNase depletion of exosomal RNA abolishes CD206 induction; antagomiR-125b-5p in recipient macrophages

limitation_zh: 未做在体miR-125b-5p敲降；EV剂量按颗粒数单次给药，时间窗较短。
limitation_en: No in vivo miR-125b-5p knockdown; single particle-count dose and a short observation window.

title: Platelet-rich plasma-derived exosomes establishing a muscular proregenerative microenvironment through enhancing the viability of fibro-adipogenic progenitors.
injury_model: glycerol-induced fatty infiltration of tibialis anterior
species: mouse; human PRP donors (young vs old)
ev_source: platelet-rich plasma (PRP-exo), young (Y) vs old (O) donors
dose: 1.0 × 10^9 exosomes per TA in vivo; 1.0 × 10^8 exosomes in vitro
mechanism_chain: PRP-exo let-7f-5p / miR-16-5p → TGFBR3 (−) → KRT10 degradation (−) → ERK-PPARγ (−) → FAP adipogenesis (−) → fatty infiltration (−)
PRP-exo → FAP viability (+) and pro-regenerative supporting capacity (+)
donor ageing → PRP-exo efficacy (−)

causal_test.what: RNA depletion of exosomes; let-7f-5p and miR-16-5p inhibitors; FAP-conditional TGFBR3 knockout in vivo

limitation_zh: 脂肪浸润为主要终点，肌纤维CSA与力学数据较弱；供体年龄显著影响疗效，限制转化。
limitation_en: Fatty infiltration is the primary endpoint with weaker fibre-CSA/force data; donor age strongly modulates efficacy, limiting translation.

title: Sphingolipids in Extracellular Vesicles Released From the Skeletal Muscle Plasma Membrane Control Muscle Stem Cell Fate During Muscle Regeneration.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury of tibialis anterior; TNF-α-conditioned EV comparison
ev_source: skeletal muscle cells (myotubes): small EVs (sEV) vs large EVs (lEV), basal vs TNF-α
isolation_method: ultracentrifugation with SEC/density-gradient and ultrafiltration validation
dose: 30 µg EV in 25 µL PBS per TA
mechanism_chain: SkM-sEV S1P subspecies → macrophage M1 polarisation and migration (early, +) → MuSC differentiation (+) → repair (+)
SkM-lEV → MuSC proliferation modulation and impaired M1→M2 transition (−)
TNF-α exposure → sEV S1P ratio shift → regenerative function (−)

causal_test.what: lipidomic fractionation plus sEV/lEV comparison; treatment of isolated fibres; no genetic S1P-pathway knockout

limitation_zh: 脂质机制主要靠相关性与分组比较；无S1P受体拮抗/敲除的在体因果实验。
limitation_en: The lipid mechanism rests on correlation and subgroup comparison; no in vivo S1P-receptor antagonism or knockout.
notes: Rare lipid-cargo (non-miRNA) mechanism; also the clearest sEV vs lEV contrast.

title: MiR-126-5p Derived From Bone Marrow Mesenchymal Stem Cell Exosomes Promotes Skeletal Muscle Regeneration by Regulating FBXO32/MyoD Signaling.
injury_model: BaCl2 (1.2%) injury of gastrocnemius
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC exosomes, control vs miR-126 knockdown
route_schedule: local intramuscular injection into injured muscle; AAV-miR-126 arm
mechanism_chain: BMSC-exo miR-126-5p → FBXO32 (−) → MyoD ubiquitination/degradation (−) → MyoD (+) → Pax7+ SC proliferation and differentiation (+) → regeneration (+)

causal_test.what: miR-126 knockdown in donor BMSCs abolishes the effect; AAV-mediated miR-126-5p overexpression reproduces it

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；FBXO32-MyoD轴的在体泛素化证据有限。
limitation_en: Dose not reported, and in vivo evidence for FBXO32-mediated MyoD ubiquitination is limited.
notes: Clean loss-of-function on the donor side (knockdown EVs), which is the strongest form of cargo attribution.

title: Combinational regenerative inductive effect of bio-adhesive hybrid hydrogels conjugated with hiPSC-derived myofibers and its derived EVs for volumetric muscle regeneration.
injury_model: volumetric muscle loss
ev_source: hiPSC-derived myofibers and muscle precursor cells, in tyramine-gelatin (GelTA) hybrid hydrogel
mechanism_chain: hiPSC-myofiber EV + integrin-mediated adhesion → myogenic markers (+), fusion/differentiation index (+)
EV + hydrogel → muscle tissue regeneration (+) and functional restoration (+)
limitation_zh: EV与水凝胶/细胞的贡献未分离；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: EV, hydrogel and cell contributions are not separated; dose not reported.

title: Extracellular vesicles-delivered circDB promotes ischemic muscle repair through the miR-34a/USP7/Notch1 signaling pathway.
injury_model: hindlimb ischemia (femoral artery ligation)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC EVs (UMSC-EV), ± si-circDB
isolation_method: total EV isolation kit after UC-cleared medium
dose: 100 µg EVs per mouse at three sites; 100 µg/mL in vitro
mechanism_chain: UMSC-EV circDB → miR-34a (−) → USP7 (+) → Notch1 deubiquitination/stabilisation (+) → myoblast proliferation (+) → ischemic muscle repair (+)

causal_test.what: si-circDB EVs lose efficacy in vivo; miR-34a mimic/inhibitor; Co-IP for USP7-Notch1

limitation_zh: 恢复可能同时源自血流改善；无纤维化定量。
limitation_en: Recovery may be partly driven by perfusion; fibrosis is not quantified.

title: Targeted delivery of engineered extracellular vesicles to simultaneously promote vascularization and muscle regeneration in ischemic limbs.
injury_model: critical limb ischemia
ev_source: human iPSC-derived MSC (iMSC) EVs engineered via enhanced N-cadherin cell-matrix interaction, cloaked in platelet membrane with ischemia-homing peptide
cargo_implicated: miR-126, miR-21, miR-296, miR-182; PDGF-BB, VEGF, bFGF, HGF (co-upregulated)
mechanism_chain: N-cadherin-enhanced interaction → EV pro-angiogenic + pro-myogenic cargo (+)
engineered EV → endothelial and myoblast survival, migration, morphogenesis under ischemia (+)
targeted EV → blood perfusion fully restored by day 28 → skeletal muscle regeneration (+)

causal_test.what: no single-cargo knockdown; effect attributed to the combined cargo profile

limitation_zh: 多因子共同上调导致机制归因困难；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: With many factors up-regulated together, mechanistic attribution is difficult; dose not reported.

title: Rhodiola rosea-derived exosome-like nanovesicles inhibit vascular endothelial pyroptosis in the treatment of limb skeletal muscle ischemic injury through the TXNIP/NLNP3 pathway.
injury_model: limb skeletal muscle ischemic injury
ev_source: Rhodiola rosea-derived exosome-like nanovesicles (RhELN; plant EV)
mechanism_chain: RhELN novel-miR-115-5p → TXNIP (−) → NLRP3 (−) → endothelial pyroptosis (−) → angiogenesis (+)
RhELN → inflammation (−), fibrosis (−), muscle atrophy (−), limb gangrene (−), blood flow (+)

causal_test.what: target prediction plus in vitro validation; no in vivo miRNA knockdown

limitation_zh: 植物EV的标准化与定量困难；剂量未报告；跨界miRNA机制争议较大。
limitation_en: Plant EVs are hard to standardise and quantify, dose is not reported, and cross-kingdom miRNA mechanisms remain contested.

title: IMRC-exo alleviates limb injury by inhibiting ferroptosis in a rabbit model of deinagkistrodon acutus snakebite envenomation.
injury_model: Deinagkistrodon acutus snakebite envenomation limb injury
ev_source: immunity-and-matrix regulatory cells (IMRC, hESC-derived MSC) exosomes
dose: 7.5 × 10^10 particles
route_schedule: subcutaneous injection after envenomation (antivenom given to all)
mechanism_chain: IMRC-exo → iron deposition, ROS, MDA, 4-HNE (−); ACSL4, NOX1, COX2 (−); GSH, SOD, GPX4, FTH1 (+) → ferroptosis (−)
IMRC-exo → limb circumference (−), serum CK and myoglobin (−), muscle apoptosis (−)

causal_test.what: no ferroptosis inhibitor/inducer arm

limitation_zh: 毒液损伤模型与放射/机械损伤差异大；仅24小时急性期，n=6/组。
limitation_en: A venom-injury model differs substantially from radiation or mechanical injury; acute 24-h window only, n=6 per group.

journal: J Venom Anim Toxins Incl Trop Dis
title: IMRC-Exo mitigates Deinagkistrodon acutus venom-induced limb injury in rabbits by inhibiting GSDME-dependent pyroptosis.
injury_model: Deinagkistrodon acutus venom-induced limb injury
ev_source: IMRC (hESC-derived MSC) exosomes
dose: 7.5 × 10^10 particles
mechanism_chain: IMRC-exo → caspase-3/cleaved caspase-3 (−), GSDME/N-GSDME (−) → pyroptosis (−) → HMGB1, IL-1β, IL-18 (−) → muscle injury (−)
limitation_zh: 与PMID 40628981同一模型的平行报道，终点重叠；仅24小时。
limitation_en: A parallel report on the same model as PMID 40628981 with overlapping endpoints; 24 h only.

title: Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stromal cell exosomes ameliorate aging-associated skeletal muscle atrophy and dysfunction in SAMP10 mice.
injury_model: age-related sarcopenia (SAMP10 senescence-accelerated mice)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC exosomes
mechanism_chain: hucMSC-Exo → p-mTOR (+), Sirt1 (+), PGC-1α (+) → mitochondrial biogenesis (+), lipid droplet accumulation (−)
hucMSC-Exo → MHC (+) → skeletal muscle morphology and performance (+)
in vitro: Bcl-2 (+), myogenin/MyoD1/Myf5/Myf6 (+), p-AMPK (+), p-ERK1/2 (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；通路归因基于表达变化而无抑制剂验证。
limitation_en: Dose not reported and pathway attribution rests on expression changes without inhibitor validation.

title: C2C12-Derived ApoVs Promote Skeletal Muscle Development and Ameliorate Age-Related Muscle Loss Through Igf1r/PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway.
injury_model: age-related muscle loss (15-month-old mice) and muscle development (8-week-old mice)
ev_source: C2C12 myoblast-derived apoptotic EVs (apoVs)
isolation_method: not fully reported (TEM, markers cleaved CASP3/Alix/TSG101)
route_schedule: administration to young and aged mice
mechanism_chain: apoptosis during myogenic differentiation → apoV production (+) (ZVAD reduces apoV 5.91e10 → 1.77e10 and MyHC 1.05 → 0.38)
apoV IGF1R → PI3K/AKT/mTOR activation (+) → myogenic differentiation (+) → age-related muscle loss (−)

causal_test.what: Igf1r knockdown or PI3K inhibition abolishes the apoV effect; ZVAD apoptosis blockade

limitation_zh: 因果在体外；在体效应量以Cohen's d报告，样本n=6。
limitation_en: Causal tests are in vitro; in vivo effects are reported as Cohen's d with n=6.

title: hUC-MSCs and derived exosomes attenuate DEX-induced muscle atrophy through modulation of estrogen signaling pathway.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy (20 mg/kg i.p.)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC (hUC-MSC) and derived exosomes
dose: 100 µg exosomes (cell comparator 1 × 10^6 cells/kg)
cargo_implicated: estrogen-signalling-related cargo (ERα46, ERα36, ERβ, estradiol increased)
mechanism_chain: MSC-Exo → ERα/ERβ and estradiol (+) → PI3K/AKT/mTOR (+) and ERK1/2 (+) → MyHC (+)
MSC-Exo → FOXO3 (−), MAFbx (−), MuRF1 (−), TNF-α/IL-6/IL-1β (−), caspase-3 (−), p62 (−); Beclin-1 (+), Bcl-2/Bax (+)
MSC-Exo > hUC-MSC for myotube proliferation and differentiation

causal_test.what: pathway inhibitors not used; SNG162 comparator only

limitation_zh: 雌激素通路机制为转录组推断，无受体拮抗验证。
limitation_en: The estrogen-pathway mechanism is transcriptome-inferred without receptor-antagonist validation.

title: Myostatin knockout mice muscle derived exosome inhibited dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy
ev_source: skeletal muscle tissue of myostatin-knockout (MSTN−/−) mice (KO-EXO) vs wild type (WT-EXO)
mechanism_chain: MSTN−/− muscle exosomes → atrophy genes/proteins (−) → myofibre CSA (+), lean mass (+), fusion index (+)
candidate mediators miR-455-3p and miR-143-5p (not functionally validated)

causal_test.what: miRNA candidates identified by sequencing only

limitation_zh: miRNA仅测序层面，未功能验证；剂量未报告；供体为基因敲除小鼠，转化性受限。
limitation_en: miRNA candidates are sequencing-level only without functional validation, dose is unreported, and donors are knockout mice, limiting translation.

title: Chinese leek-derived extracellular vesicles ameliorate sarcopenia by regulating mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy via AMPK and maintaining myosin homeostasis.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced sarcopenia (C2C12 myotube atrophy plus sarcopenic mice)
ev_source: Chinese leek-derived EVs (CL-EV; plant EV)
mechanism_chain: CL-EV → AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α (+) → mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy (+) → ATP (+), ROS (−), membrane potential stabilised
CL-EV → Akt/FoxO3a (−) → Atrogin-1 (−), MuRF1 (−) → myotube diameter (+)
CL-EV → gut microbiota dysbiosis (−) (gut-muscle axis)

causal_test.what: multi-omics plus western blot; no genetic/pharmacological pathway block

limitation_zh: 通路归因缺乏抑制剂验证；剂量未报告；肠道轴证据为相关性。
limitation_en: Pathway attribution lacks inhibitor validation, dose is unreported, and the gut-axis evidence is correlative.

title: Bovine colostrum-derived exosomes alleviate muscle degeneration by modulating gut microbiota and metabolic homeostasis in atrophy models.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy (mouse) plus C. elegans and C2C12
ev_source: bovine colostrum-derived exosomes (BCE)
mechanism_chain: BCE → MuRF1 (−), atrogin-1 (−) → myotube viability and myogenic differentiation (+)
BCE → gut microbiota (Lachnospiraceae +, Muribaculaceae +, Bacteroidaceae −) → cholesterol (−); succinic acid and L-alanine restored
functional_outcomes: C. elegans lifespan and myogenic genes
limitation_zh: 在体肌肉终点（CSA、握力）报告薄弱，主要为代谢与菌群指标；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: In vivo muscle endpoints (CSA, grip strength) are weakly reported, with metabolic and microbiome readouts dominating; dose unreported.

title: Probiotic-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Attenuate Sarcopenia via Muscle Regeneration.
injury_model: palmitic-acid-induced C2C12 atrophy and hindlimb immobilisation (HI) sarcopenia
ev_source: Lentilactobacillus kefiri DH5 postbiotic EVs (bacterial EV)
cargo_implicated: GAPDH, arginine deiminase, S-layer protein with CBS domains (proteomics)
mechanism_chain: DH5-EV → Igf-1 (+) → myotube integrity restored
DH5-EV → MyoD (+), Atrogin-1 (−) → grip strength (+), muscle mass (+) (comparable to creatine)
limitation_zh: 细菌EV内毒素与批次控制问题未讨论；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Endotoxin and batch control for bacterial EVs are not discussed and dose is not reported.

title: Aptamer-Conjugated Exosomes Ameliorate Diabetes-Induced Muscle Atrophy by Enhancing SIRT1/FoxO1/3a-Mediated Mitochondrial Function.
injury_model: diabetes-associated muscle atrophy (db/db mice)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC exosomes, with or without skeletal-muscle-targeting aptamer (Apt-EXO)
dose: 200 µg MSC- or Apt-EXOs per injection
route_schedule: tail vein every 3 days for 6 weeks (from 5 weeks of age)
mechanism_chain: MSC-EXO → SIRT1 (+) → FoxO1/FoxO3a (−) → mitochondrial complex function (+) → MuRF1 (−), Atrogin-1 (−)
MSC-EXO → grip strength (+), TA/soleus mass (+), fibre CSA (+), slow-to-fast fibre ratio (+)
aptamer conjugation → muscle targeting (+) → all effects amplified

causal_test.what: SIRT1 siRNA knockdown in myotubes abolishes the anti-atrophic effect

limitation_zh: SIRT1敲降仅体外；糖尿病模型的代谢改善可能间接贡献肌肉获益。
limitation_en: SIRT1 knockdown was in vitro only, and metabolic improvement in the diabetic model may indirectly contribute to the muscle benefit.

title: Anemarrhena asphodeloides-derived small extracellular vesicle ameliorate diabetes-induced muscle atrophy via activating Pink1-mediated mitophagy.
injury_model: diabetes-induced muscle atrophy (db/db mice; high-glucose C2C12)
ev_source: Anemarrhena asphodeloides-derived small EVs (AA-sEV; plant EV)
mechanism_chain: AA-sEV → Pink1/Parkin-dependent mitophagy (+) → mitochondrial ROS (−) → MyoG/MyoD1 anabolic programme (+); MuRF1/MAFbx catabolic programme (−)
AA-sEV → grip strength (+), hanging endurance (+), myofibre CSA (+), FNDC5 (+)

causal_test.what: mitophagy inhibitor 3-MA abolishes the anabolic/catabolic regulation under hyperglycaemia (in vitro)

limitation_zh: 口服植物EV的生物利用度与肌肉实际递送未定量；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Bioavailability and actual muscle delivery of orally administered plant EVs are not quantified and dose is unreported.

title: Treatment of Denervated Muscle Atrophy by Injectable Dual-Responsive Hydrogels Loaded with Extracellular Vesicles.
injury_model: denervated muscle atrophy after nerve injury and reconstruction
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC (HUC-MSC) EVs in an ultrasound- and pH-responsive injectable hydrogel (EVs@UR-gel)
route_schedule: injectable hydrogel depot with controlled EV release
mechanism_chain: EV@UR-gel (sustained EV bioactivity) → muscle strength 89.53 ± 0.96%, circumference 76.02 ± 7.49%, wet weight 88.0 ± 2.65% of healthy controls; sciatic nerve index −0.11 ± 0.09
limitation_zh: 水凝胶与EV的贡献未分离；剂量与货物未报告。
limitation_en: Hydrogel and EV contributions are not separated and neither dose nor cargo is reported.

title: Extracellular Vesicles from Regenerating Skeletal Muscle Mitigate Muscle Atrophy in an Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Mouse Model.
injury_model: ALS-related muscle atrophy (SOD1-G93A mice); donor EVs from CTX-injured regenerating muscle at day 14
ev_source: regenerating skeletal muscle 14 days after cardiotoxin injury (CTXD14SkM-EV)
dose: ≈4.4 × 10^9 EVs in 20 µL PBS per mouse (TA and gastrocnemius)
cargo_implicated: anti-inflammatory EV profile (not resolved to one cargo)
mechanism_chain: CTXD14SkM-EV → macrophage M1→M2 shift (+) → NF-κB signalling (−) → muscle protein degradation (−)
CTXD14SkM-EV → myoblast differentiation and fusion (+) under TNF-α → muscle regeneration (+) → atrophy (−)

causal_test.what: no NF-κB inhibitor or cargo knockdown arm

limitation_zh: n=5小鼠；神经退行性病因未被EV纠正，仅肌肉端获益。
limitation_en: n=5 mice; the neurodegenerative cause is not corrected by EVs, with benefit confined to the muscle compartment.
notes: Interesting donor concept: EVs harvested from the anti-inflammatory phase of regenerating muscle.

title: hBMSC-EVs alleviate weightlessness-induced skeletal muscle atrophy by suppressing oxidative stress and inflammation.
injury_model: weightlessness/hindlimb-unloading (tail suspension) muscle atrophy; C2C12 nutrient deprivation
ev_source: human bone-marrow MSC EVs (hBMSC-EV)
dose: 10 × 10^8 particles/mL in vitro (best); 1 × 10^10 particles/mL in vivo
mechanism_chain: hBMSC-EV → ROS (−) and inflammatory response (−) → ubiquitin-proteasome (−) and autophagy-lysosome (−) protein degradation (−)
hBMSC-EV → Sirt1 (+), PGC-1α (+) → slow-to-fast fibre-type transition (−)
→ soleus mass (+), fibre CSA (+), grip strength (+)

causal_test.what: dose-response in vitro only

limitation_zh: 有效货物未鉴定；通路归因无抑制剂验证。
limitation_en: Active cargo is unidentified and pathway attribution lacks inhibitor validation.

title: Secretome enriched with small extracellular vesicles derived from human gingiva-derived mesenchymal stem cells enhances rat tongue muscle regeneration.
injury_model: rat tongue muscle defect (excisional wound)
ev_source: human gingiva-derived MSC cultured under xeno-free induction (iGMSC) secretome enriched in small EVs
isolation_method: ultrafiltration concentration plus 35 nm qEV size-exclusion separation of EV and soluble fractions
route_schedule: topical application of concentrated CM/secretome to the wound bed
cargo_implicated: EV-related gene signature; oxidative phosphorylation, Wnt/β-catenin, Notch pathway enrichment
mechanism_chain: iGMSC secretome (EV-enriched) → macrophage IL-10 (+), LPS-induced TNF-α (−)
iGMSC secretome → myogenic transcription factors in myoblasts and human muscle progenitors (+)
→ tongue wound repair without fibrosis/scar or shape deformity

causal_test.what: EV and soluble fractions were separated in vitro but the in vivo arm used the whole secretome

limitation_zh: 在体使用的是整体分泌组而非纯化EV，EV特异性未证实；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The in vivo arm used the whole secretome rather than purified EVs, so EV specificity is unproven; dose unreported.
notes: Borderline inclusion: EV fraction was isolated and tested in vitro only.

title: Exosomal miR-24-3p mediates myoblast-macrophage crosstalk to promote abdominal muscle repair.
injury_model: abdominal muscle injury
ev_source: M2 macrophage exosomes carrying miR-24-3p
route_schedule: administration to the abdominal muscle injury model
mechanism_chain: M2 macrophage exosomal miR-24-3p → C2C12 metabolic activity, proliferation, migration and differentiation (+)
exosomal miR-24-3p → muscle fibre damage (−), fibrosis (−), inflammation (−); glucose and lipid metabolism restored

causal_test.what: cargo identified and delivered, but no in vivo inhibitor arm

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；下游靶基因未明确。
limitation_en: Dose unreported and the downstream target gene is not identified.

title: Umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomal Follistatin inhibits fibrosis and promotes muscle regeneration in mice by influencing Smad2 and AKT signaling.
injury_model: mouse muscle injury model plus C2C12 myotube atrophy
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC exosomes (UMSC-Exo), ± si-Follistatin
route_schedule: administration in the muscle injury model
cargo_implicated: Follistatin (protein cargo, enriched in exosomes relative to parent cells)
mechanism_chain: UMSC-Exo Follistatin → Myostatin (−) → MuRF1 (−), MAFbx (−); MyHC (+), MyoD (+)
UMSC-Exo → α-SMA (−), Collagen I (−) → fibrosis (−); Smad2 and AKT/mTOR signalling modulated
si-Follistatin exosomes lose all effects

causal_test.what: si-Follistatin-loaded exosomes reverse the effect; oe-Smad2 and LY294002 define the downstream arms

limitation_zh: Smad2磷酸化方向在摘要中表述不一致，需以全文为准；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The direction of Smad2 phosphorylation is reported inconsistently in the abstract and needs the full text; dose unreported.
notes: Rare protein-cargo (Follistatin) causal test with donor-side knockdown.

title: Adipose-derived small extracellular vesicle miR-146a-5p targets Fbx32 to regulate mitochondrial autophagy and delay aging in skeletal muscle.
injury_model: skeletal muscle ageing in aged mice; C2C12
ev_source: white adipose tissue small EVs enriched in miR-146a-5p
mechanism_chain: adipose sEV miR-146a-5p → Fbx32/atrogin-1 (−) and FoxO3 pathway → mitochondrial autophagy and apoptosis regulated → ROS (−), ATP (+)
→ muscle atrophy in aged mice (−), muscle fibre growth and repair (+)

causal_test.what: miR-146a-5p mimic and inhibitor in C2C12; target validation of Fbx32

limitation_zh: 剂量与给药方案未报告；在体因果验证有限。
limitation_en: Dose and schedule are unreported and in vivo causal validation is limited.

journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Reciprocal communication between FAPs and muscle cells via distinct extracellular vesicle miRNAs in muscle regeneration.
injury_model: BaCl2 acute injury of tibialis anterior
ev_source: immortalised FAPs (iFAP) and muscle cells (MuSC/myoblast/myotube)
isolation_method: sequential ultracentrifugation (+ SEC for dye removal)
dose: ≈1.2 × 10^9 EVs per TA
mechanism_chain: FAP-EV miR-127-3p → S1pr3 (−) → myogenesis (+) → regenerating myofibres with central nuclei (+)
MuSC/myotube-EV miR-206-3p and miR-27a/b-3p → FAP adipogenesis (−) → intramuscular adipose tissue (−)

causal_test.what: RNase-protection test of EV lumen cargo; miR mimics in FAPs; Pdgfrα+ cell depletion (iDTR) context arm

limitation_zh: miR-127-3p的在体敲降未做，疗效来自永生化FAP的EV，与原代FAP可能不同。
limitation_en: No in vivo miR-127-3p knockdown; the therapeutic EVs come from immortalised FAPs, which may differ from primary FAPs.
notes: Defines the bidirectional FAP↔MuSC EV loop - a key module for fibro-adipogenic remodelling.

title: Myogenic exosome miR-140-5p modulates skeletal muscle regeneration and injury repair by regulating muscle satellite cells.
injury_model: BaCl2 (1.2%) injury of gastrocnemius
ev_source: myogenic progenitor cells (MPC-Exo), loaded with miR-140-5p mimic or inhibitor
dose: 2.3 × 10^10 particles/mL, 50 µL per injection
mechanism_chain: MPC-Exo140− (miR-140-5p inhibitor) → Pax7 de-repression (+) → satellite cell G1→S transition → proliferation (+) → muscle repair (+)
miR-140-5p → Pax7 (−) (direct target)

causal_test.what: engineered EV loading of mimic vs inhibitor; AAV-miR-140-5p inhibitor arm in vivo; luciferase target validation

limitation_zh: 治疗效果来自抑制内源miRNA而非补充；未报告肌力或CSA定量。
limitation_en: The benefit comes from inhibiting an endogenous miRNA rather than supplementing one; force and CSA quantification are not reported.

title: Mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomal microRNA-367-3p mitigates lower limb ischemia/reperfusion injury in mouse skeletal muscle via EZH2 targeting.
injury_model: lower limb ischemia/reperfusion injury
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC exosomes ± miR-367-3p loading
mechanism_chain: BMSC-exo miR-367-3p → EZH2 (−) → pyroptosis-related proteins (−) → skeletal muscle injury (−)

causal_test.what: luciferase validation of EZH2 as a miR-367-3p target; loaded vs unloaded EV comparison

limitation_zh: 报告简略，剂量/时间点缺失；EZH2轴仅荧光素酶验证。
limitation_en: Sparse reporting with no dose or timepoints; the EZH2 axis rests on a luciferase assay alone.

title: Hypoxic preconditioning-engineered bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes promote muscle satellite cell activation and skeletal muscle regeneration via the miR-210-3p/KLF7 mechanism.
injury_model: age-related sarcopenia (aged rats)
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC exosomes, normoxic (N-Exos) vs hypoxic preconditioned (H-Exos)
route_schedule: administration to aged rats (in vivo and in vitro arms)
mechanism_chain: H-Exos miR-210-3p → KLF7 (−) → PI3K/AKT phosphorylation (+) → satellite cell proliferation and differentiation (+) → skeletal muscle regeneration and functional recovery (+)

causal_test.what: miR-210-3p and KLF7 manipulation in satellite cells in vitro

limitation_zh: 因果验证限于体外；剂量与给药方案未报告。
limitation_en: Causal validation is limited to in vitro work; dose and schedule are not reported.

title: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes ameliorate muscle atrophy via the miR-132-3p/FoxO3 axis.
injury_model: age-related and dexamethasone-induced (20 mg/kg/day i.p., 14 days) muscle atrophy
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC exosomes (hucMSC-Exos)
dose: 40 µg per injection (DEX model); 20 µg per injection (ageing model); 40 µg/mL in vitro
route_schedule: tail vein every 3 days — 15 days (DEX model) or 8 weeks (ageing model)
mechanism_chain: hucMSC-Exo miR-132-3p → FoxO3 (−) → MuRF1 (−), atrogin-1 (−) → grip strength (+), muscle mass (+), fibre CSA (+)

causal_test.what: miR-132-3p mimic/inhibitor loaded into exosomes (Exo-Fect) reverses the effect

limitation_zh: 两种模型剂量不同，未做剂量-效应；FoxO3为生信+验证，非唯一靶点。
limitation_en: Different doses in the two models with no dose-response, and FoxO3 is a bioinformatics-led target rather than the only one.

title: Gouqi-derived nanovesicles (GqDNVs) inhibited dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy associating with AMPK/SIRT1/PGC1α signaling pathway.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy
ev_source: Gouqi (Lycium barbarum) berry-derived nanovesicles (GqDNV; plant EV)
cargo_implicated: saccharides and lipids (non-targeted metabolome); no single effector
mechanism_chain: GqDNV → AMPK (+) → SIRT1 (+) → PGC1α (+) → quadriceps CSA (+), grip strength (+)
GqDNV → amino-sugar/nucleotide-sugar metabolism, autophagy and oxidative phosphorylation (+)

causal_test.what: AMPK or PGC1α inhibition in C2C12 shows AMPK is the dominant mediator of GqDNV-induced proliferation

limitation_zh: 因果验证仅在体外；植物纳米囊泡批次标准化困难，剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Causal validation is in vitro only; plant nanovesicles are hard to standardise between batches and the dose is not reported.

title: Satellite Cell-Derived Exosomes: A Novel Approach to Alleviate Skeletal Muscle Atrophy and Fibrosis.
injury_model: denervation-induced muscle atrophy and fibrosis
ev_source: muscle satellite cells (MuSC-Exo)
mechanism_chain: MuSC-Exo → TGF-β1 (−) → Smad3 (−) → Pax7 axis → fibroblast activation (−) → fibrosis (−) and atrophy (−)

causal_test.what: single-cell RNA-seq informed; no pathway inhibitor arm

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；TGF-β1/Smad3-Pax7轴未做抑制/过表达验证。
limitation_en: Dose not reported and the TGF-β1/Smad3-Pax7 axis is not validated by inhibition or overexpression.

title: HucMSCs Delay Muscle Atrophy After Peripheral Nerve Injury Through Exosomes by Repressing Muscle-Specific Ubiquitin Ligases.
injury_model: muscle atrophy after sciatic nerve crush injury
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC (hucMSC) and hucMSC-EXOs
dose: cell comparator 1 × 10^6 cells in 200 µL PBS; EV dose stated per preparation
route_schedule: local injection into gastrocnemius under ultrasound guidance on postoperative days 1 and 7
mechanism_chain: hucMSC-EXO miR-23b-3p → Fbxo32/atrogin-1 (−) and Trim63/MuRF-1 (−) → myotube atrophy (−) → gastrocnemius atrophy (−)

causal_test.what: miR-23b-3p inhibitor reverses the protection in vitro; dual-luciferase target validation

limitation_zh: EV具体剂量报告不清；在体未做miR-23b-3p阻断。
limitation_en: The EV dose is unclear and miR-23b-3p was not blocked in vivo.

title: Administration of adipose-derived stem cells extracellular vesicles in a murine model of spinal muscular atrophy: effects of a new potential therapeutic strategy.
injury_model: spinal muscular atrophy (SMNΔ7 severe SMA model)
ev_source: adipose-derived stem cell EVs (ASC-EV)
dose: 0.5 µg per administration
route_schedule: intracerebroventricular injection at postnatal days 3 and 6
cargo_implicated: protein, miRNA and mRNA cargo (not resolved)
mechanism_chain: ASC-EV → motor neuron degeneration (−), cleaved caspase-3 (−), glial activation (−) → motor performance (+)
ASC-EV → muscle atrophy and fibre denervation only partially limited (peripheral effect weak)
limitation_zh: 给药途径为脑室内，肌肉获益间接且有限；剂量极低。
limitation_en: Delivery is intracerebroventricular, so the muscle benefit is indirect and limited; the dose is very low.

title: Wnt7a is required for regeneration of dystrophic skeletal muscle.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury in mdx mice with muscle-specific Wnt7a deletion (Myf5-Cre; Wnt7a-floxed)
ev_source: extracellular vesicles containing Wnt7a (Wnt7a-EV)
mechanism_chain: muscle Wnt7a deletion → regeneration (−) and specific force (−) after CTX
Wnt7a-EV (systemic) → regeneration deficit in mdx rescued → endogenous Wnt7a upregulation is required for regeneration

causal_test.what: conditional Wnt7a knockout plus EV rescue - a genuine loss-of-function/rescue design

limitation_zh: EV剂量未报告；单次给药、仅21天终点。
limitation_en: EV dose unreported, single administration, single 21-day endpoint.
notes: Strong genetic rescue design; cargo is a protein (Wnt7a), not a miRNA.

title: Magnetic-field-driven targeting of exosomes modulates immune and metabolic changes in dystrophic muscle.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse)
ev_source: annexin A1-primed myo-exosomes (Exomyo) immobilised on ferromagnetic nanotubes, magnetically targeted
route_schedule: systemic injection with external magnetic field guidance
mechanism_chain: magnetic targeting → Exomyo biodistribution to skeletal muscle (+) → macrophage uptake dominant → beneficial immune and metabolic muscle responses (+)

causal_test.what: quantitative muscle-level uptake analysis identifies macrophages as the dominant recipient

limitation_zh: 以递送为核心，肌肉功能学终点有限；铁磁纳米管的长期安全性未评估。
limitation_en: A delivery-focused study with limited muscle functional endpoints, and the long-term safety of ferromagnetic nanotubes is not assessed.

title: Exosomes Secreted During Myogenic Differentiation of Human Fetal Cartilage-Derived Progenitor Cells Promote Skeletal Muscle Regeneration through miR-145-5p.
injury_model: sarcopenia rat model; myoblast differentiation in vitro
species: rat; human fetal cartilage-derived progenitor cells (hFCPC)
ev_source: exosomes secreted during myogenic differentiation of hFCPC (F-Exo), compared with human BM-MSC exosomes (B-Exo)
mechanism_chain: F-Exo miR-145-5p → Wnt5a (+) and β-catenin (+) → MyoD, MyoG, MyHC (+) → myotube formation (+)
F-Exo → muscle fibre CSA (+) and muscle mass (+) > B-Exo

causal_test.what: RNase pretreatment reduces efficacy; miR-145-5p mimic reproduces and inhibitor partially negates the effect

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；因果验证在体外，Wnt通路为表达层面证据。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, causal validation is in vitro, and the Wnt evidence is at expression level only.

title: MSCs-derived apoptotic extracellular vesicles promote muscle regeneration by inducing Pannexin 1 channel-dependent creatine release by myoblasts.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury of tibialis anterior
ev_source: MSC-derived apoptotic EVs (ApoEV)
dose: 30 µg ApoEV in 20 µL per TA (contralateral TA = PBS control)
timepoints: day 3 treatment; regeneration readouts after CTX
cargo_implicated: Pannexin 1 channel (membrane protein on ApoEV); creatine as effector metabolite
mechanism_chain: MSC-ApoEV → activated Pannexin 1 channel on vesicle membrane → creatine release by myoblasts (+) → myoblast fusion index (+) → multinucleated regenerating fibres (+)

causal_test.what: Pannexin 1 inhibitor BB-FCF abolishes creatine release and fusion

limitation_zh: 因果验证主要在体外；在体仅单次给药与组织学终点，无力学测试。
limitation_en: Causal testing is mainly in vitro; in vivo arm is a single dose with histology only, no force testing.
notes: Unusual non-miRNA mechanism (metabolite release via Pannexin 1).

title: A Ready-to-Use Purified Exosome Product for Volumetric Muscle Loss and Functional Recovery.
injury_model: volumetric muscle loss of lateral gastrocnemius
ev_source: commercial purified exosome product (PEP, platelet-derived), with fibrin sealant; PRP comparator
dose: 5% PEP in vitro (2.5/5/10% dose-response); in vivo delivered with fibrin sealant
route_schedule: local delivery into the VML defect
mechanism_chain: PEP → myoblast proliferation (+) and migration (+)
PEP + fibrin → isometric tetanic force (+ at day 90) and cellularity (+ at days 45 and 90)

causal_test.what: no mechanism arm

limitation_zh: 商业制剂成分不透明；机制未探讨。
limitation_en: The composition of the commercial product is not transparent and no mechanism is explored.

title: Enrichment of miR-17-5p enhances the protective effects of EPC-EXs on vascular and skeletal muscle injury in a diabetic hind limb ischemia model.
injury_model: diabetic hindlimb ischemia (db/db mice)
ev_source: endothelial progenitor cells (EPC-EX), ± miR-17-5p enrichment
dose: 1 × 10^11 EXs per 100 µL
route_schedule: intramuscular into gastrocnemius once every 7 days for 3 weeks
mechanism_chain: EPC-EX miR-17-5p → SPRED1 (−) → PI3K (+) → p-Akt (+) → apoptosis (−), myotube formation (+), EC tube formation (+)
EPC-EX(miR-17-5p) → blood flow (+), microvessel density (+), gastrocnemius weight (+), force production (+), structural integrity (+)

causal_test.what: PI3K inhibitor LY294002 abolishes the Akt/functional effects in vitro; engineered miR enrichment vs native EV comparison

limitation_zh: PI3K抑制剂仅在体外使用；糖尿病背景限制向非糖尿病肌损伤外推。
limitation_en: The PI3K inhibitor was used only in vitro, and the diabetic background limits extrapolation to non-diabetic muscle injury.

title: Intravenous Infusion of Exosomes Derived from Human Adipose Tissue-Derived Stem Cells Promotes Angiogenesis and Muscle Regeneration: An Observational Study in a Murine Acute Limb Ischemia Model.
injury_model: acute limb ischemia (hindlimb arteries cut and burned)
ev_source: human adipose tissue-derived stem cells (ADSC-exo)
mechanism_chain: ADSC-exo → Flk1, Vwf, Ang1, Tgfb1 (+) → angiogenesis (+)
ADSC-exo → Myod, Myf5 (+) → muscle regeneration (+) → limb mobility (+)
limitation_zh: 观察性研究、样本量小（n=3 功能学），SpO2无差异。
limitation_en: Observational design with very small functional groups (n=3) and no difference in SpO2.

title: Lyophilized Extracellular Vesicles from Adipose-Derived Stem Cells Increase Muscle Reperfusion but Degrade Muscle Structural Proteins in a Mouse Model of Hindlimb Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury.
injury_model: hindlimb ischemia-reperfusion (90-min tourniquet)
ev_source: adipose stem cells, lyophilised EVs
dose: 0, 50 or 100 µg EV
cargo_implicated: annexin A1 (increased in muscle after EV)
mechanism_chain: ASC-EV → reperfusion (+) and annexin A1 (+) (anti-inflammatory)
ASC-EV → muscle structural proteins dystrophin, plectin, obscurin (−) [adverse]
ASC-EV → serum TNF-α and IL-6 (+); serum TNF-α correlates with reperfusion level

causal_test.what: dose-response only

limitation_zh: 罕见的负面结果：EV在I/R中增加再灌注但降解肌结构蛋白，提示并非所有模型都获益。
limitation_en: A rare negative result: EVs increased reperfusion but degraded muscle structural proteins, showing that benefit is not universal across models.
notes: Important counterexample for the pathway map - flag the adverse arm.

title: Extracellular vesicles derived from human ESC-MSCs target macrophage and promote anti-inflammation process, angiogenesis, and functional recovery in ACS-induced severe skeletal muscle injury.
injury_model: acute compartment syndrome (ACS)-induced severe skeletal muscle injury
ev_source: human embryonic stem cell-derived MSC (ESC-MSC-EV)
dose: 100 µg EV per rat
route_schedule: intravenous (dorsal penis vein) at the time of fasciotomy
mechanism_chain: ESC-MSC-EV miRNAs → PTEN (−), NLRP3 (−), mTOR, TLR3 → macrophage polarisation toward anti-inflammatory phenotype
→ NF-κB, JAK/STAT, PI3K/AKT pathway modulation → inflammation (−), angiogenesis (+), functional recovery (+)
ESC-MSC-EV → iNOS (−), Bcl-2 (+), Bax (−), cleaved caspase-3 (−), serum CK (−)

causal_test.what: clodronate-liposome macrophage depletion reduces EV efficacy

limitation_zh: 多miRNA-多通路归因较弱，单一货物未验证；仅3天短期终点。
limitation_en: Attribution across many miRNAs and pathways is weak with no single cargo validated, and the endpoint is only 3 days.

title: Neuromuscular electrical stimulation enhances the ability of serum extracellular vesicles to regenerate aged skeletal muscle after injury.
injury_model: aged skeletal muscle injury, with neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) conditioning of donors
ev_source: circulating serum EVs from aged animals after NMES
cargo_implicated: CD63 surface expression (reduced); lipid and sugar content shifts (Raman fingerprint)
mechanism_chain: NMES → circulating EV biochemical profile shift → aged muscle healing after injury (+)
limitation_zh: 货物未鉴定，剂量未报告；拉曼指纹为描述性。
limitation_en: Cargo is unidentified and dose unreported; the Raman fingerprint is descriptive.

title: Nanotopographical Cues Tune the Therapeutic Potential of Extracellular Vesicles for the Treatment of Aged Skeletal Muscle Injuries.
injury_model: aged skeletal muscle injury (plus bioengineered 3D muscle ageing model)
ev_source: young muscle stem/progenitor cells cultured on flat (fEV) vs nanograting (nEV) substrates
route_schedule: sequential administration: fEV on day 1 (proliferative phase) then nEV on day 3 (differentiation phase)
timepoints: day 1 and day 3 dosing; regeneration readouts
mechanism_chain: fEV → aged MPC proliferation (+)
nEV → myogenic differentiation (+)
sequential fEV→nEV → aged muscle regeneration (+) > either alone or mixed → myofibre size (+), functional recovery (+)

causal_test.what: administration-schedule comparison only

limitation_zh: 拓扑调控EV的具体货物未知；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The cargo responsible for topography tuning is unknown and the dose is not reported.
notes: Key timing principle: proliferation-phase vs differentiation-phase EVs are not interchangeable.

title: Development of a cell-free strategy to recover aged skeletal muscle after disuse.
injury_model: hindlimb immobilisation (disuse) and recovery, adult and aged mice
ev_source: healthy donor pericytes primed with H2O2 (primed sEV)
route_schedule: administration during the recovery period after immobilisation
cargo_implicated: 11 differentially regulated proteins (ECM, anti-inflammatory and antioxidant)
mechanism_chain: disuse → pericyte antioxidant capacity (−)
H2O2-primed pericyte sEV → ECM remodelling and antioxidant/anti-inflammatory proteins → myofibre size recovery (+)

causal_test.what: proteomic association only

limitation_zh: 有效蛋白未逐一验证；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The candidate proteins were not individually validated and dose is not reported.

title: Hierarchically Injectable Hydrogel Sequentially Delivers AntagomiR-467a-3p-Loaded and AntagomiR-874-5p-Loaded Satellite-Cell-Targeting Bioengineered Extracellular Vesicles Attenuating Sarcopenia.
injury_model: ovariectomy-induced sarcopenia
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC EVs engineered with surface TSG101 for satellite-cell targeting, loaded with antagomiR-467a-3p or antagomiR-874-5p, in an injectable hydrogel
route_schedule: sequential intramuscular injection (EVs-467a then EVs-874), or sustained hydrogel release
mechanism_chain: EV-antagomiR-467a → satellite cell stemness (+)
EV-antagomiR-874 → satellite cell myogenesis (+)
sequential EV delivery (hydrogel-sustained) → sarcopenia (−)

causal_test.what: EV-delivered vs free antagomiR comparison; sequential vs single delivery

limitation_zh: 两种antagomiR的靶基因机制链较浅；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The downstream target mechanism of the two antagomiRs is shallow and dose is not reported.

title: Mesenchymal stromal cells ameliorate diabetes-induced muscle atrophy through exosomes by enhancing AMPK/ULK1-mediated autophagy.
injury_model: diabetes- and obesity-induced muscle atrophy (db/db, high-fat diet, hindlimb immobilisation)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC (hucMSC) and derived exosomes (MSC-EXO)
dose: 200 µg MSC-EXO per injection (cell comparator 1 × 10^6 cells)
route_schedule: tail vein every 3 days for 8 weeks (cells: weekly ×8; IM arm weekly ×4)
mechanism_chain: hucMSC/MSC-EXO → AMPK (+) → ULK1 (+) → autophagy (+) → Atrogin-1 (−), MuRF1 (−) → fibre CSA (+), muscle mass (+)
→ grip strength (+), running endurance (+)

causal_test.what: AMPKα2 siRNA knockdown or 3-MA autophagy inhibition abolishes the benefit

limitation_zh: 三种模型剂量统一但无剂量-效应；因果实验在体外完成。
limitation_en: A single dose across three models with no dose-response, and the causal experiments were done in vitro.
notes: One of the few papers to show the same EV effect across three independent atrophy models.

title: Red blood cell extracellular vesicles deliver therapeutic siRNAs to skeletal muscles for treatment of cancer cachexia.
injury_model: cancer cachexia (tumour-bearing mice)
ev_source: red blood cell-derived EVs (RBCEV) loaded with siRNA against myostatin (Mstn) or malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
mechanism_chain: RBCEV-siMstn → myostatin (−) → muscle growth (+) → cachexia (−)
RBCEV-siMcd → fatty-acid metabolism corrected → cachexia (−)
RBCEV uptake by myofibres, non-inflammatory

causal_test.what: siRNA knockdown is the intervention; naked siRNA comparator

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；RBC-EV货物装载效率与肿瘤生长影响未分离。
limitation_en: Dose unreported and the siRNA loading efficiency and any effect on tumour growth are not separated.

title: Amniotic Membrane-Derived Stromal Cells Release Extracellular Vesicles That Favor Regeneration of Dystrophic Skeletal Muscles.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse)
species: mouse (mdx, 1.5 months); human myoblasts and mouse MuSC
ev_source: human amniotic membrane-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (hAMSC)
isolation_method: not fully reported (NTA, SEM, CD81/Alix WB)
dose: 20 µL EVs ≈ 3.2 × 10^9 vesicles per tibialis anterior
route_schedule: intramuscular once a week for 21 days (3 injections)
mechanism_chain: EV hAMSC → Pax7+/Ki67+ activated MuSC (+) → new fibre formation (+)
EV hAMSC → collagen deposition (−) → fibrosis (−)

causal_test.what: EV vs whole conditioned medium comparison only

limitation_zh: 全分泌组效应强于纯化EV，提示EV非唯一有效成分；无力学终点。
limitation_en: The whole secretome outperformed purified EVs, so EVs are not the only active component; no force endpoint.

title: Polarized macrophages regulate fibro/adipogenic progenitor (FAP) adipogenesis through exosomes.
injury_model: massive rotator cuff tendon tear with supraspinatus atrophy and fatty infiltration
ev_source: M0, M1 and M2 polarised macrophage exosomes
dose: 2 × 10^9 exosomes per injection (and per FAP culture)
route_schedule: injection into supraspinatus muscle after massive tendon tear
mechanism_chain: M2 macrophage exosomes → FAP brown/beige adipogenic differentiation (+) → muscle atrophy (−) and fatty infiltration (−)
M1 and M0 exosomes lack this effect; GW4869 blockade of exosome release abolishes the macrophage effect

causal_test.what: GW4869 exosome-release blockade in the macrophage-FAP co-culture; polarisation-state comparison

limitation_zh: n=6/组；有效货物未鉴定；仅单一6周终点。
limitation_en: n=6 per group, the active cargo is unidentified, and there is a single 6-week endpoint.
notes: Mirror image of PMID 35604307 - both converge on beige FAP differentiation as the anti-fatty-infiltration module.

title: Exosomal Plasminogen Activator Inhibitor-1 Induces Ionizing Radiation-Adaptive Glioblastoma Cachexia.
injury_model: ionizing-radiation-adaptive cancer cachexia (irradiated glioblastoma, orthotopic xenograft)
ev_source: exosomes from irradiated glioblastoma cells (pathogenic)
route_schedule: endogenous tumour exosome release; TM5441 (PAI-1 inhibitor) as blocking intervention
mechanism_chain: ionizing radiation → GBM exosomal PAI-1 release (+)
exosomal PAI-1 → muscle STAT3 phosphorylation (+) → MuRF1 (+), Atrogin-1 (+) → muscle atrophy (+)
exosomal PAI-1 → mTOR signalling (−) → muscle protein synthesis (−)
TM5441 (PAI-1 inhibition) → atrophy (−), protein synthesis (+), survival (+)

causal_test.what: pharmacological PAI-1 inhibition (TM5441)

limitation_zh: EV为致病介质；GBM荷瘤模型，肌肉效应与肿瘤负荷/恶病质难以分离。
limitation_en: EVs are the pathogenic mediator; in a GBM-bearing model the muscle effect cannot be cleanly separated from tumour burden/cachexia.
notes: Radiation-context pathogenic EV axis (IR → tumour exosome → muscle). Relevant to radiation gap analysis.

title: Myoblast-derived exosomes promote the repair and regeneration of injured skeletal muscle in mice.
injury_model: BaCl2 (1.2%) injury of gastrocnemius
ev_source: C2C12 myoblasts
dose: 6.4 × 10^10 particles/mL, 50 µL per injection
cargo_implicated: exosomal mRNA/protein cargo (transcriptome + proteome of recipient SCs); no single effector
mechanism_chain: myoblast-exo → satellite cell PCNA (+) → proliferation (+); Pax7 (+)
myoblast-exo → FAP PPARγ (+) adipogenic capacity (+) and α-SMA (−) fibrogenic capacity (−) → fibrosis (−) (Collagen-1 −, α-SMA −)

causal_test.what: no cargo knockdown

limitation_zh: 把损伤肌肉脂肪生成增加解读为获益存在争议；无力学终点。
limitation_en: Interpreting increased adipogenesis in injured muscle as a benefit is debatable; no force endpoint.

title: Silk sericin patches delivering miRNA-29-enriched extracellular vesicles-decorated myoblasts (SPEED) enhances regeneration and functional repair after severe skeletal muscle injury.
injury_model: severe tibialis anterior injury
ev_source: miR-29-enriched EVs used to decorate primary myoblasts on a silk sericin patch (SPEED)
route_schedule: patch implantation at the injury site
mechanism_chain: miR29-EV → myoblast myotube formation (+), myogenic genes (+), fibrotic genes (−)
SPEED → CDC20-MEF2C axis (−) → regeneration (+)
SPEED → fibrosis (−), contraction force (+), motor ability (+)

causal_test.what: no direct miR-29 knockdown in vivo

limitation_zh: EV、肌母细胞与丝胶支架三者效应无法分离；CDC20-MEF2C轴为生信推断。
limitation_en: The EV, myoblast and sericin-patch contributions cannot be separated, and the CDC20-MEF2C axis is a bioinformatic inference.

title: Delivery of engineered extracellular vesicles with miR-29b editing system for muscle atrophy therapy.
injury_model: immobilisation- and denervation-induced muscle atrophy; in vitro Dex, AngII and TNF-α atrophy
ev_source: engineered EVs delivering a CRISPR/Cas9 system targeting miR-29b (EVs-Cas9-29b)
route_schedule: administration in immobilisation and denervation models
mechanism_chain: EV-Cas9-29b → miR-29b repression (specific and rapid) → muscle atrophy (−) under Dex, AngII and TNF-α → muscle function preserved in vivo

causal_test.what: gene-editing specificity of miR-29b repression is the intervention itself

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；CRISPR载荷的脱靶与递送效率未充分评估。
limitation_en: Dose is unreported and off-target effects and delivery efficiency of the CRISPR cargo are not fully assessed.

title: Muscle-Derived Beige Adipose Precursors Secrete Promyogenic Exosomes That Treat Rotator Cuff Muscle Degeneration in Mice and Are Identified in Humans by Single-Cell RNA Sequencing.
injury_model: massive rotator cuff tear (supraspinatus)
ev_source: fibro-adipogenic progenitors in a beige/brown adipose state (FAP-BAT, UCP1++); Exo-FB vs Exo-nFB
route_schedule: injection at the time of rotator cuff injury
cargo_implicated: BAT/mitochondrial and exosome surface markers (UCP1++ subpopulation)
mechanism_chain: FAP-BAT (UCP1++) exosomes → myotube fusion index (+); fibroblast→myotube conversion (+)
Exo-FB in vivo → muscle atrophy (−), fatty infiltration (−) vs Exo-nFB or PBS
a transcriptomically similar FAP-BAT subpopulation exists in human rotator cuff

causal_test.what: Exo-FB vs Exo-nFB subpopulation comparison (donor-cell state as the variable)

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；人源数据仅为单细胞测序的存在性证据。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, and the human data are only single-cell evidence that the subpopulation exists.

title: Exosome biopotentiated hydrogel restores damaged skeletal muscle in a porcine model of stress urinary incontinence.
injury_model: stress urinary incontinence with external urethral sphincter damage (porcine); rodent latissimus dorsi injury
ev_source: human platelet-derived EV product (PEP; CD41a+, CD9+, enriched for NF-κB and PD-L1)
route_schedule: PEP-biopotentiated collagen-1 or fibrin glue hydrogel with sustained release
mechanism_chain: PEP → satellite cell NF-κB-dependent proliferation and differentiation (+) (fully blocked by resveratrol)
PEP hydrogel → new skeletal muscle formation (+) and local macrophage M2 polarisation (+) → external urethral sphincter function restored

causal_test.what: resveratrol NF-κB inhibition abolishes the in vitro effect

limitation_zh: 大动物（猪）数据可贵但样本小；剂量未报告；水凝胶与EV贡献未分离。
limitation_en: Valuable large-animal (porcine) data but small samples; dose unreported and hydrogel vs EV contributions are not separated.
notes: One of very few large-animal studies in this field.

title: Inhibiting uptake of extracellular vesicles derived from senescent bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells by muscle satellite cells attenuates sarcopenia.
injury_model: sarcopenia in aged mice; senescent BMSC EV uptake by satellite cells
ev_source: senescent bone-marrow MSC EVs (pathogenic)
route_schedule: EV-uptake blockade rather than EV administration
mechanism_chain: senescent BMSC-EV → CD81-mediated binding to satellite cell membrane proteins → EV uptake → satellite cell myogenic potential (−) → muscle atrophy (+)
anti-CD81 antibody or CD81 siRNA → uptake (−) → sarcopenia in aged mice attenuated

causal_test.what: CD81 knockdown and antibody blockade in vivo; biotin pulldown of the CD81 interaction

limitation_zh: 干预是阻断EV摄取而非给予EV；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The intervention blocks EV uptake rather than delivering EVs; dose unreported.
notes: Therapeutically important inverse strategy: block harmful EV uptake.

title: Atrophic skeletal muscle fibre-derived small extracellular vesicle miR-690 inhibits satellite cell differentiation during ageing.
injury_model: ageing-induced muscle atrophy; sEVs from atrophic myotubes
species: mouse (aged); human muscle samples; satellite cells
ev_source: atrophic skeletal muscle fibres/myotubes (pathogenic sEV)
route_schedule: in vitro treatment plus intramuscular AAV to overexpress or silence miR-690
mechanism_chain: atrophic myotube sEV miR-690 → Mef2a, Mef2c, Mef2d (−) → satellite cell differentiation (−) (35% in vivo) → muscle atrophy (+)
miR-690 silencing in muscle → satellite cell differentiation (+) → atrophy in aged mice (−)

causal_test.what: AAV-mediated miR-690 overexpression and silencing in vivo; luciferase target validation

limitation_zh: 治疗端用AAV而非EV；人源验证仅为表达相关性（n=10）。
limitation_en: The therapeutic arm uses AAV rather than EVs, and the human validation is expression correlation only (n=10).
notes: miR-690/MEF2 is the mirror image of the pro-myogenic miRNA module.

title: Adipose-derived exosomes block muscular stem cell proliferation in aged mouse by delivering miRNA Let-7d-3p that targets transcription factor HMGA2.
injury_model: ageing-associated sarcopenia; perimuscular adipose tissue transplanted into young mouse thigh
ev_source: aged perimuscular adipose tissue (PMAT) exosomes (pathogenic)
mechanism_chain: aged adipocyte Lin28A/B (−) and NF-κB (+) → Let-7d-3p accumulation in PMAT exosomes (+)
PMAT exosomal Let-7d-3p → HMGA2 (−) → muscular stem/progenitor cell self-renewal and proliferation (−) → atrophy (+)

causal_test.what: exosome-mediated transfer confirmed; HMGA2 target validation

limitation_zh: EV为致病介质；移植模型的机械/旁分泌混杂因素未排除。
limitation_en: EVs act as pathogenic mediators and mechanical/paracrine confounders of the transplant model are not excluded.
notes: Adipose→muscle pathogenic axis; HMGA2 is the pro-self-renewal node.

title: Muscle functional recovery is driven by extracellular vesicles combined with muscle extracellular matrix in a volumetric muscle loss murine model.
injury_model: volumetric muscle loss (VML) with decellularised muscle ECM scaffold
ev_source: Wharton-jelly MSC
route_schedule: implanted with muscle ECM at the VML site
mechanism_chain: MSC-EV + muscle ECM → M2-like macrophages (+) → inflammation directed to repair
MSC-EV → angiogenesis (+), myogenesis (+), fibrosis (−) → functional recovery (+)

causal_test.what: no cargo or pathway causal arm

limitation_zh: EV与ECM支架的贡献无法分离；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: EV and ECM-scaffold contributions cannot be separated; dose not reported.

title: Bone Marrow Stromal Cell-Derived Exosomes Promote Muscle Healing Following Contusion Through Macrophage Polarization.
injury_model: contusion (hit injury) of tibialis anterior
ev_source: bone-marrow stromal cells (BMSC-Exo)
mechanism_chain: BMSC-Exo → macrophage M2 polarisation (+) in vivo and in vitro → inflammatory cytokines (−), anti-inflammatory factors (+)
BMSC-Exo → fibrotic area (−), regeneration (+), biomechanical property (+)

causal_test.what: clodronate-liposome macrophage depletion abolishes the benefit

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；未鉴定起效货物。
limitation_en: Dose not reported and the active cargo is not identified.
notes: Macrophage-depletion arm makes this one of the strongest causal tests of the M2 module.

title: Regulation of aged skeletal muscle regeneration by circulating extracellular vesicles.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury of tibialis anterior in aged mice (heterochronic serum/EV transfer)
ev_source: serum EVs from young vs aged mice (and Klotho+/− donors)
dose: EV number matched to the amount removed by depletion (repletion design)
route_schedule: serial tail-vein injections of serum ± EV depletion; EV injection 3 days post-injury
mechanism_chain: young serum EV α-Klotho transcript → recipient Klotho (+) → myofibre CSA (+), contractile function (+), cell bioenergetics (+)
serum EV depletion → benefit of young blood abolished → EVs are required mediators of heterochronic benefit
ageing → EV subpopulation heterogeneity shift (nucleic acid, not protein fingerprint) → downstream benefit (−)

causal_test.what: EV depletion from young serum abolishes benefit; EV repletion restores it; Klotho siRNA and Klotho+/− donor EVs test transcript dependence

limitation_zh: 血清EV异质性高、剂量以“等量回补”界定；衰老修复效应与系统性因子难完全分离。
limitation_en: Serum EVs are heterogeneous and dose is defined only as equivalent repletion; the rejuvenation effect cannot be fully separated from other systemic factors.
notes: Best depletion/repletion causal design in the whole set.

title: BMSC-Derived Exosomes Inhibit Dexamethasone-Induced Muscle Atrophy via the miR-486-5p/FoxO1 Axis.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced muscle atrophy (5 mg/kg/day i.p., 2 weeks)
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC exosomes (BMSC-Exo), and miR-486-5p-inhibitor-loaded exosomes
dose: 100 µg exosomes in PBS per injection
route_schedule: multi-point intramuscular injection every 2 days for 2 weeks
mechanism_chain: BMSC-Exo miR-486-5p → FoxO1 nuclear translocation (−) → atrophy programme (−) → myotube diameter (+) and muscle atrophy (−)

causal_test.what: miR-486-5p-inhibitor-loaded exosomes reverse the protective effect in vivo and in vitro

limitation_zh: 未报告握力/CSA的完整功能学数据；FoxO1下游（MuRF1/atrogin-1）验证有限。
limitation_en: Full functional data (grip strength/CSA) are not reported and validation of FoxO1 downstream targets is limited.

title: SKP-SC-EVs Mitigate Denervated Muscle Atrophy by Inhibiting Oxidative Stress and Inflammation and Improving Microcirculation.
injury_model: sciatic denervation-induced muscle atrophy
ev_source: skin precursor-derived Schwann cells (SKP-SC-EV)
dose: 5 × 10^10 EV particles in 20 µL PBS per muscle (in vitro 4-32 × 10^8 particles/mL, dose-dependent)
mechanism_chain: SKP-SC-EV → Nrf2 (+), Nox2/Nox4 (−) → ROS (−)
SKP-SC-EV → IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α (−) → inflammation (−)
SKP-SC-EV → MuRF1 (−), MAFbx (−) (ubiquitin-proteasome) and PINK1/BNIP3/LC3B/ATG7 (−) (autophagy-lysosome) → muscle wet weight ratio (+), fibre CSA (+), MyHC degradation (−)
SKP-SC-EV → vascular endothelial proliferation (+) → microvessels and blood perfusion (+)

causal_test.what: dose-response in vitro only; no Nrf2 knockout arm

limitation_zh: 通路众多但缺乏关键因果验证（如Nrf2敲除）；有效货物未鉴定。
limitation_en: Many pathways are implicated but the key causal test (e.g. Nrf2 knockout) is missing and the active cargo is unidentified.
notes: Most complete multi-module in vivo dataset for denervation atrophy.

title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Exosomes Protect Muscle Loss by miR-145-5p Activity Targeting Activin A Receptors.
injury_model: chemotherapy (busulfan-cyclophosphamide)-induced muscle loss, with elevated serum activin A
ev_source: tonsil-derived MSC (T-MSC) exosomes
dose: 30 µg per mouse in vivo; 5 µg/mL in vitro
route_schedule: lateral tail vein on day 3 of chemotherapy
timepoints: sacrifice 4-5 days after the last cyclophosphamide dose
mechanism_chain: T-MSC exo miR-145-5p → ACVR2A (−) and ACVR1B (−) (activin A receptors) → activin A signalling (−) → myotube differentiation (+) → body weight and muscle mass preserved

causal_test.what: miR-145-5p inhibitor (in vitro and in vivo jetPEI) abolishes the rescue

limitation_zh: 化疗模型全身毒性显著，肌肉特异性有限；观察窗短。
limitation_en: Systemic chemotherapy toxicity limits muscle specificity and the observation window is short.

title: Casein-enhanced uptake and disease-modifying bioactivity of ingested extracellular vesicles.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse), oral EV delivery
ev_source: cardiac stromal cell EVs formulated with casein
mechanism_chain: casein → EV uptake after ingestion (+) → blood cell gene expression altered → mdx muscle function (+)
limitation_zh: 口服EV的吸收量与肌肉实际递送未定量；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: Absorption and actual muscle delivery of orally given EVs are not quantified; dose unreported.
notes: Only oral-route EV study with a muscle functional endpoint.

title: Exosome-mediated improvement in membrane integrity and muscle function in dystrophic mice.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse)
ev_source: exosomes from several sources, with myotube-derived exosomes most effective
mechanism_chain: exosomes → sarcolemma membrane integrity (+) → intracellular calcium influx (−) → calpain protease activation (−) → degradation of destabilised dystrophin-associated protein complex (−) → muscle function (+)

causal_test.what: source comparison only; no calpain-pathway knockout arm

limitation_zh: 膜稳定机制与常见miRNA范式不同，但缺乏分子层面的因果验证；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The membrane-stabilisation mechanism differs from the usual miRNA paradigm but lacks molecular causal validation; dose unreported.
notes: Mechanistically distinct (physical membrane repair rather than signalling).

title: Engineered extracellular vesicle decoy receptor-mediated modulation of the IL6 trans-signalling pathway in muscle.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse); C2C12 myoblasts and myotubes
ev_source: EVs engineered to display IL6ST (gp130) decoy receptors with a GCN4 dimerisation domain and a syntenin-1-derived EV-targeting peptide
mechanism_chain: IL6ST decoy EV → IL6 trans-signalling (−) (classical signalling unaffected) → STAT3 phosphorylation (−) in quadriceps and gastrocnemius
IL6ST decoy EV → reversal of IL6/IL6R-induced differentiation block in myotubes (+)

causal_test.what: selective inhibition of trans- but not classical signalling demonstrates target specificity

limitation_zh: 在体终点仅为信号分子（p-STAT3），无肌力/CSA等功能学结果；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The in vivo endpoint is a signalling molecule (p-STAT3) only, with no force or CSA data; dose unreported.
notes: Rare engineered-surface-protein (decoy receptor) EV design.

title: Exosomes Derived by SIRT1-Overexpressing Bone Marrow Mesenchymal Stem Cells Improve Pubococcygeus Muscle Injury in Rats.
