injury_model: stress urinary incontinence (vaginal dilation, pubococcygeus injury)
ev_source: SIRT1-overexpressing human BMSC exosomes (SIRT1/exos)
mechanism_chain: SIRT1/exos → ERK signalling (+) → satellite cell proliferation, differentiation and activation (+) → abdominal leak point pressure (+) and maximum bladder volume (+)

causal_test.what: engineered donor overexpression vs native exosome comparison only

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；无ERK抑制剂验证；与PMID 30849996机制重叠。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, no ERK-inhibitor validation, and the mechanism overlaps with PMID 30849996.

title: M2 Macrophage-derived exosomal miR-501 contributes to pubococcygeal muscle regeneration.
injury_model: pubococcygeus muscle injury (stress urinary incontinence model)
ev_source: M2 macrophage exosomes (M2-EXO)
mechanism_chain: M2-EXO miR-501 → YY1 (−) → C2C12 myoblast differentiation and myotube formation (+)
M2-EXO → inflammatory cell infiltration (−) → damaged pubococcygeus muscle repair (+)

causal_test.what: miR-501 identified as selectively loaded and confirmed to target YY1

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；在体仅为组织学与炎症终点。
limitation_en: Dose unreported and the in vivo arm uses histology and inflammation endpoints only.

title: Skeletal Muscle Regeneration by the Exosomes of Adipose Tissue-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells.
injury_model: surgical muscle defect (biopsy punch of quadriceps)
ev_source: human adipose tissue-derived MSC exosomes (AD-MSC exosomes)
mechanism_chain: AD-MSC exosomes → satellite cell proliferation (+) and myocyte-related genes (+)
→ myogenin (+), MyoD (+) → preserved muscle bundle shape and size
limitation_zh: 免疫缺陷小鼠模型掩盖了免疫调节效应；n=6/组，剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The immunodeficient host masks any immunomodulatory effect; n=6 per group and dose unreported.

title: Exosomes Isolated From Platelet-Rich Plasma and Mesenchymal Stem Cells Promote Recovery of Function After Muscle Injury.
injury_model: lengthening-contraction (strain) injury of tibialis anterior
ev_source: platelet-rich plasma (PRP-exo) and bone-marrow MSC (MSC-exo)
route_schedule: intramuscular immediately after injury and at days 5 and 10
mechanism_chain: PRP-exo → Myogenin (+) → regeneration (+)
MSC-exo → TGF-β (−) → fibrosis (−)
both → centrally nucleated fibres (+) → isometric torque recovery (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；两种EV来源的机制差异仅为基因表达相关性。
limitation_en: Dose not reported; the mechanistic difference between the two EV sources rests on gene-expression correlation only.

title: Stem cell-derived exosomes prevent pyroptosis and repair ischemic muscle injury through a novel exosome/circHIPK3/ FOXO3a pathway.
injury_model: hindlimb ischemia (femoral artery ligation)
ev_source: human umbilical cord MSC (UMSC-Exo), ± si-circHIPK3
dose: 100 µg exosomes per mouse, split over three intramuscular injection points
mechanism_chain: UMSC-Exo circHIPK3 → miR-421 (−) → FOXO3a (+) → NLRP3 / cleaved caspase-1 (−) → IL-1β, IL-18 (−) → pyroptosis (−)
UMSC-Exo → blood perfusion (+), running distance (+), muscle force (+)

causal_test.what: si-circHIPK3-loaded exosomes abolish all benefits in vivo; miR-421 mimic/inhibitor and luciferase assay in vitro

limitation_zh: 缺血模型以灌注为主要驱动，肌纤维CSA/纤维化数据有限。
limitation_en: In an ischemia model perfusion is the main driver, and fibre-CSA/fibrosis data are limited.
notes: Strongest causal design among the ischemia studies (loss-of-function EVs in vivo).

title: Extracellular Vesicles From Adipose Stem Cells Prevent Muscle Damage and Inflammation in a Mouse Model of Hind Limb Ischemia: Role of Neuregulin-1.
injury_model: hindlimb ischemia
ev_source: adipose stem cells (ASC-EV)
mechanism_chain: ASC-EV NRG1 → muscle cell protection (+), MyoD in satellite cells (+) → muscle function (+)
ASC-EV → vascular growth (+) and inflammatory cell recruitment modulation
ASC-EV → apoptosis (−) in vitro and in vivo

causal_test.what: NRG1-blocking antibody in vivo abolishes muscle protection, vascular growth and inflammatory recruitment

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；NRG1抗体为中和实验，未做EV内NRG1敲降。
limitation_en: Dose not reported; NRG1 was neutralised with an antibody rather than knocked down within the EVs.
notes: Rare protein-cargo (not miRNA) causal test.

title: Effects of exosome-mediated delivery of myostatin propeptide on functional recovery of mdx mice.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse)
ev_source: exosomes surface-anchored with myostatin propeptide via the second extracellular loop of CD63 (EXOpro)
mechanism_chain: EXOpro → mature myostatin inhibition (+) → muscle regeneration and growth (+) → muscle mass (+) and functional rescue (+)
EXOpro → bone structure and regeneration (+) (secondary)

causal_test.what: surface anchoring vs free propeptide comparison shows the delivery platform is required

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；长期安全性与myostatin持续抑制的风险未评估。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, and the long-term safety of sustained myostatin inhibition is not assessed.

title: Secretome of adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells promotes skeletal muscle regeneration through synergistic action of extracellular vesicle cargo and soluble proteins.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury of skeletal muscle
ev_source: adipose-derived MSC secretome, whole secretome vs isolated EV fraction
mechanism_chain: ADSC-EV fraction → muscle regeneration rate (+)
soluble fraction + EV fraction act synergistically (each affects different aspects in vitro/in vivo)
limitation_zh: EV与可溶组分的分工为描述性；无机制通路的因果验证。
limitation_en: Division of labour between EV and soluble fractions is descriptive; no causal pathway test.

title: Exosome-Mediated miR-29 Transfer Reduces Muscle Atrophy and Kidney Fibrosis in Mice.
injury_model: unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced muscle wasting
ev_source: engineered exosomes (Lamp2b-RVG targeting vector) loaded with miR-29 (Exo/miR29)
mechanism_chain: Exo/miR-29 → YY1 (−) and TGF-β3 (−) → muscle cross-sectional area (+), TRIM63/MuRF1 (−), FBXO32/atrogin-1 (−)
Exo/miR-29 (muscle-to-kidney transfer) → renal TGF-β, α-SMA, fibronectin, collagen 1A1 (−) → renal fibrosis (−)

causal_test.what: engineered cargo loading plus fluorescent EV tracing; direct target validation of YY1 and TGF-β3

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；CKD模型的肌肉获益部分可能继发于肾脏改善。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, and in a CKD model part of the muscle benefit may be secondary to renal improvement.

title: miR-26a Limits Muscle Wasting and Cardiac Fibrosis through Exosome-Mediated microRNA Transfer in Chronic Kidney Disease.
injury_model: chronic kidney disease (5/6 nephrectomy) muscle wasting
ev_source: satellite cells transfected with muscle-targeting Lamp2b vector, loaded with miR-26a (Exo/miR-26a)
route_schedule: intramuscular injection into tibialis anterior once per week for 8 weeks
mechanism_chain: Exo/miR-26a → muscle miR-26a (+) → FBXO32/atrogin-1 (−), TRIM63/MuRF1 (−) → skeletal muscle CSA (+)
Exo/miR-26a → cardiac FoxO1 activation (−) → CTGF, fibronectin, collagen 1α1 (−) → cardiac fibrosis (−), cardiac function (+)

causal_test.what: engineered miR loading with muscle-targeting peptide; compared with control exosomes

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；肌肉与心脏效应交织。
limitation_en: Dose unreported and muscle and cardiac effects are intertwined.

title: Exogenous miR-26a suppresses muscle wasting and renal fibrosis in obstructive kidney disease.
injury_model: unilateral ureteral obstruction muscle wasting
ev_source: exosomes engineered to encapsulate miR-26a
mechanism_chain: Exo/miR-26a → FoxO1 (−) → myostatin (−) → muscle weight (+)
Exo/miR-26a → CTGF (−) and TGF-β1 (−) in kidney → renal fibrosis (−)

causal_test.what: direct target suppression of CTGF/FoxO1 shown; engineered cargo

limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；与PMID 30711446/31037144同一课题组、模型高度重叠。
limitation_en: Dose unreported, and the model and group heavily overlap with PMIDs 30711446 and 31037144.

title: Disease-modifying bioactivity of intravenous cardiosphere-derived cells and exosomes in mdx mice.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse)
ev_source: cardiosphere-derived cells (CDC) and their exosomes
mechanism_chain: CDC exosomes → mdx heart and skeletal muscle transcriptome normalisation → cardiac and skeletal muscle function (+), regenerative capacity (+)

causal_test.what: exosome-mediated mechanism inferred from CDC/exosome equivalence

limitation_zh: 单次给药、剂量未报告；转录组“正常化”为描述性终点。
limitation_en: Single dose with unreported amount, and transcriptome 'normalisation' is a descriptive endpoint.

title: Exosomes Isolated From Adipose-Derived Stem Cells: A New Cell-Free Approach to Prevent the Muscle Degeneration Associated With Torn Rotator Cuffs.
injury_model: massive rotator cuff tear (bilateral supraspinatus and infraspinatus tenotomy)
ev_source: human adipose-derived stem cells (ASC-Exos)
mechanism_chain: ASC-Exo → muscle atrophy (−), fatty infiltration (−), inflammation (−), vascularisation modulated → myofibre regeneration (+) and biomechanical properties (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；无机制探讨；啮齿动物自愈能力强，作者自承需大动物验证。
limitation_en: Dose unreported with no mechanism, and the authors themselves note that rodent regenerative capacity requires large-animal confirmation.

title: Exosomes secreted by urine-derived stem cells improve stress urinary incontinence by promoting repair of pubococcygeus muscle injury in rats.
injury_model: stress urinary incontinence from vaginal balloon dilation (pubococcygeus muscle injury)
ev_source: human urine-derived stem cells (USC-Exo)
dose: 1 × 10^10 particles/mL, 1 mL local injection
route_schedule: local injection into and around the pubococcygeus muscle
mechanism_chain: USC-Exo → satellite cell ERK phosphorylation (+) → satellite cell activation, proliferation and differentiation (+) → muscle repair (+) → urodynamic parameters (+)

causal_test.what: ERK inhibitor PD98059 (150 µM) abolishes the pro-proliferative effect in vitro

limitation_zh: 因果验证仅体外；盆底肌模型与四肢骨骼肌损伤差异较大。
limitation_en: Causal validation is in vitro only, and a pelvic-floor model differs considerably from limb skeletal muscle injury.

title: Extracellular Vesicles Secreted by Human Urine-Derived Stem Cells Promote Ischemia Repair in a Mouse Model of Hind-Limb Ischemia.
injury_model: hindlimb ischemia
ev_source: human urine-derived stem cells (USC-EV)
cargo_implicated: growth factors measured by ELISA (not resolved to an effector)
mechanism_chain: USC-EV → HMEC-1 and C2C12 proliferation (+, dose-dependent)
USC-EV → perfusion (+), angiogenesis (+), muscle regeneration (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；机制停留在生长因子描述层面。
limitation_en: Dose not reported and the mechanism remains at the level of growth-factor description.

title: PDGF enhances the protective effect of adipose stem cell-derived extracellular vesicles in a model of acute hindlimb ischemia.
injury_model: acute hindlimb ischemia
ev_source: adipose MSC stimulated with PDGF (PDGF-EV) vs control EV
mechanism_chain: PDGF-EV → PBMC IL-10 (+) and TGF-β1 (+) → regulatory T cell formation (+) → inflammatory cell infiltration (−) → muscle protection from acute ischemia (+)
limitation_zh: 剂量未报告；无肌再生/纤维化定量终点。
limitation_en: Dose not reported; no quantitative muscle regeneration or fibrosis endpoint.

title: Exosome-Mediated Benefits of Cell Therapy in Mouse and Human Models of Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mouse; human iPSC-derived DMD cardiomyocytes)
ev_source: cardiosphere-derived cells (CDC) exosomes
route_schedule: injection (CDC intramyocardial; exosomes reproduce the benefit)
mechanism_chain: CDC exosomes → cardiac and skeletal muscle function (+), ambulatory capacity (+), survival (+)
CDC exosomes → transient partial full-length dystrophin expression in mdx (mechanism unresolved)

causal_test.what: exosomes reproduce the cell effect, but no cargo knockdown

limitation_zh: 部分肌营养不良蛋白恢复的机制不明，可能为revertant纤维；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The mechanism of partial dystrophin restoration is unclear and may reflect revertant fibres; dose is unreported.
notes: Motivated the HOPE-2 clinical trial.

title: Exosomes and exosomal miRNAs from muscle-derived fibroblasts promote skeletal muscle fibrosis.
injury_model: DMD muscle fibrosis; EVs injected into cardiotoxin-injured tibialis anterior
ev_source: muscle-derived fibroblasts of DMD patients (pathogenic EV)
mechanism_chain: DMD fibroblast exosomal miR-199a-5p → caveolin-1 (−) → Akt and ERK (+) → myofibroblast conversion (α-SMA +, collagen +, fibronectin +) → fibrosis (+)
miR-199a-5p mimic or inhibitor loaded into control exosomes produces opposite effects

causal_test.what: miR-199a-5p mimic/inhibitor loading into exosomes; caveolin-1 target

limitation_zh: EV为致病介质；剂量未报告；人源EV注入小鼠为异种实验。
limitation_en: EVs are the pathogenic mediator, dose is unreported, and human EVs in mouse muscle is a xenogeneic experiment.
notes: Defines the pro-fibrotic miR-199a-5p/caveolin-1 module - a therapeutic target rather than a therapy.

title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles as Mediators of Anti-Inflammatory Effects: Endorsement of Macrophage Polarization.
injury_model: cardiotoxin (CTX) injury of tibialis anterior
species: mouse (in vivo); human adipose MSC, mouse BM macrophages
ev_source: human adipose-derived MSC, normoxic (EV-Normo) and hypoxic (EV-Hypo) preconditioned
dose: 1 µg EV per TA in 20 µL PBS (in vitro: 1 µg EV/10,000 macrophages); 5 µg in Matrigel plug assay
route_schedule: intramuscular, 2 h after CTX plus a boost at day 4
cargo_implicated: EV protein/miRNA cargo not resolved to a single effector
mechanism_chain: ADSC-EV → macrophage M1→M2 switch: IL6 (−), Nos2 (−), Arg1 (+), Ym1 (+), CD206+ infiltrate (+)
ADSC-EV → Pax7 (+), MyoD (+), eMyHC (+) (accelerated myogenic programme)
hypoxic preconditioning → greater effect than normoxic EV
limitation_zh: 无EV货物敲降或巨噬细胞清除的因果实验；功能学（力量）终点缺失。
limitation_en: No cargo knockdown or macrophage-depletion causal arm; no functional (force) endpoint.
notes: One of the clearest M2-shift datasets with explicit EV dose per muscle.

title: Protein and Molecular Characterization of a Clinically Compliant Amniotic Fluid Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicle Fraction Capable of Accelerating Muscle Regeneration Through Enhancement of Angiogenesis.
injury_model: cardiotoxin injury
ev_source: human amniotic fluid stem cells (clinically compliant secretome; EV fraction isolated)
cargo_implicated: EV miRNA (no mRNA detected); proteomic signature
mechanism_chain: AFSC-EV → angiogenesis (+) → muscle regeneration (+)
AFSC-EV → inflammation (−)
limitation_zh: EV与可溶性分泌组的贡献部分重叠，未完全分离；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: EV and soluble secretome contributions overlap and are not fully separated; dose not reported.

title: Serum-derived extracellular vesicles (EVs) impact on vascular remodeling and prevent muscle damage in acute hind limb ischemia.
injury_model: acute hindlimb ischemia
ev_source: human serum EVs ('effective' vs 'ineffective' sEV)
cargo_implicated: TGF-β1 signalling cargo; MMP/ECM, VEGF, IGF pathway transcripts
mechanism_chain: serum EV → TGF-β1 cascade → SMAD1/5 → ID1 promoter → angiogenesis (+) → vascular remodelling (+) → muscle damage (−)

causal_test.what: SMAD1/5 knockdown and ChIP on the ID1 promoter (in vitro)

limitation_zh: 因果验证在体外；供体EV效力差异大，批次一致性差。
limitation_en: Causal testing is in vitro, and donor-to-donor EV potency varies widely, so batch consistency is poor.

title: First Characterization of Human Amniotic Fluid Stem Cell Extracellular Vesicles as a Powerful Paracrine Tool Endowed with Regenerative Potential.
injury_model: spinal muscular atrophy-related skeletal muscle atrophy (HSA-Cre, SmnF7/F7 mice)
species: mouse; human c-KIT+ amniotic fluid stem cells
ev_source: human amniotic fluid stem cells (hAFS-EV), normoxic vs 1% O2 hypoxic preconditioned
route_schedule: administration in the muscle atrophy model
cargo_implicated: regenerative microRNAs enriched by hypoxic preconditioning
mechanism_chain: hAFS-EV → proliferation, survival, immunomodulation, angiogenesis (+) in vitro
hAFS-EV → skeletal muscle inflammation (−) in vivo
hypoxic preconditioning → exosomal regenerative miRNA (+)
limitation_zh: 在体终点仅为炎症减轻，无肌量/肌力数据；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The in vivo endpoint is reduced inflammation only, with no muscle mass or force data; dose unreported.

title: Exosomes from differentiating human skeletal muscle cells trigger myogenesis of stem cells and provide biochemical cues for skeletal muscle regeneration.
injury_model: laceration injury of skeletal muscle
species: mouse (in vivo); human skeletal myoblasts/adipose stem cells (in vitro)
ev_source: differentiating human skeletal muscle cells (myotubes)
mechanism_chain: myotube exosome growth-factor cargo → adipose stem cell myogenic conversion (+)
myotube exosomes → fibrotic area (−), regenerating myofibre number (+)
functional_outcomes: myogenic differentiation of recipient stem cells
limitation_zh: 未分离EV各组分验证哪种生长因子起效；剂量与颗粒数未报告。
limitation_en: No fractionation to identify which growth factor drives the effect; dose and particle number not reported.

title: Mesenchymal-stem-cell-derived exosomes accelerate skeletal muscle regeneration.
injury_model: cardiotoxin-type acute muscle injury (in vivo muscle injury model)
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC
mechanism_chain: MSC-exo → myogenesis (+) and angiogenesis (+) in vitro
MSC-exo → muscle regeneration (+) in vivo, proposed via miR-494
limitation_zh: 方法学报告简略（短篇通讯），剂量、EV鉴定与miR-494因果验证均缺失。
limitation_en: Brief-communication format: dose, EV characterisation and causal testing of miR-494 are all absent.
notes: Early landmark paper; cargo attribution is correlative.

title: Extracellular Vesicles From Young Human Myogenic Progenitor Cells Rejuvenate Aged Cells.
injury_model: skeletal muscle ageing (in vitro heterologous young/old exchange)
species: human (vastus lateralis biopsies, young vs elderly donors)
ev_source: human myogenic progenitor cells (hMPC) from young vs elderly donors
route_schedule: in vitro treatment of recipient hMPCs
mechanism_chain: young hMPC EV → aged hMPC viability and differentiation (+)
aged hMPC EV → young hMPC regenerative capacity (−)
limitation_zh: 纯体外、无损伤模型、无在体验证。
limitation_en: In vitro only, with no injury model and no in vivo validation.

title: Exosomes Derived From Mesenchymal Stem Cells Regulating Myotube Cell Atrophy via NF-κB Signaling Pathway.
injury_model: TNF-α (20 ng/mL, 48 h) induced C2C12 myotube atrophy
ev_source: bone-marrow MSC exosomes
mechanism_chain: BMSC-Exo → IκB phosphorylation (−) → NF-κB nuclear translocation (−) → Atrogin-1 (−), MuRF-1 (−); MyoD (+) → myotube diameter and viability (+)
limitation_zh: 纯体外，仅单一细胞模型，无在体数据。
limitation_en: In vitro only, single cell model, no in vivo data.

title: MUSTN1 prevents muscle atrophy through ferroptosis suppression: A ACO1-dependent and exosome-mediated mechanism.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced myotube atrophy (in vitro)
ev_source: skeletal muscle satellite cell exosomes carrying MUSTN1
mechanism_chain: MyoD1 → MUSTN1 transcription (+) → MUSTN1 binds ACO1/IRP1 → TFRC 3'UTR interaction (+) → TFRC (+), SLC39A14 (−) → iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation (−) → ferroptosis (−)
MUSTN1-containing exosomes → myotube area, proliferation, differentiation and mitochondrial membrane potential (+)

causal_test.what: ACO1 binding and TFRC/SLC39A14 regulation shown; MUSTN1 overexpression

limitation_zh: 外泌体部分为补充性实验，无在体EV给药。
limitation_en: The exosome arm is supplementary and there is no in vivo EV administration.

title: Extracellular Vesicles From Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Drive Muscle and Neuronal Regeneration Through TNFα Modulation.
injury_model: 3D engineered human muscle construct damage model plus organotypic spinal cord and microglia
species: human muscle precursor cells; rat organotypic spinal cord
ev_source: GMP-grade mesenchymal stromal cell EVs
cargo_implicated: not identified; effect mapped to TNFα downregulation
mechanism_chain: MSC-EV → TNFα (−) → cleaved caspase-3 (−) → muscle cell death (−), proliferation (+)
MSC-EV → microglial neuroinflammation (−) → neural axon sprouting (+)

causal_test.what: protein array plus gene expression identify TNFα as the mediating node

limitation_zh: 体外3D模型，无在体数据；TNFα节点为阵列推断。
limitation_en: An in vitro 3D model with no in vivo data, and the TNFα node is inferred from an array.

title: Postbiotic Intervention in Sarcopenia: The Role of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum HY7715 and Its Extracellular Vesicles.
injury_model: TNF-α-induced C2C12 myotube atrophy (plus Caco-2 barrier model)
species: mouse cells / human cells in vitro
ev_source: heat-killed Lactiplantibacillus plantarum HY7715 and its EVs (bacterial EV)
mechanism_chain: HY7715-EV → Myf5 (+), MYOG (+) → myogenic differentiation (+)
HY7715-EV → PGC1α (+), mTOR (+) → mitochondrial activity and biogenesis (+)
HY7715-EV → Fbxo32 (−), MuRF1 (−), myostatin (−), IL6 (−)
limitation_zh: 纯体外，无在体肌肉终点。
limitation_en: In vitro only, with no in vivo muscle endpoint.

title: Glucocorticoid-Induced Muscle Satellite Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Mediate Skeletal Muscle Atrophy via the miR-335-5p/MAPK11/iNOS Pathway.
injury_model: glucocorticoid (dexamethasone)-induced muscle atrophy; EVs from Dex-treated muscle satellite cells
ev_source: dexamethasone-treated muscle satellite cells (pathogenic EV)
route_schedule: in vitro EV transfer to muscle fibre-like cells
mechanism_chain: Dex → satellite cell EV miR-335-5p (+) → MAPK11 (−) → iNOS (−) → ubiquitin-proteasome system (+) → muscle protein degradation (+) → myogenesis (−)

causal_test.what: high-throughput sequencing plus target validation of MAPK11

limitation_zh: 主要为体外细胞间传递实验，缺乏在体给药与功能学终点。
limitation_en: Mainly an in vitro cell-to-cell transfer experiment without in vivo delivery or functional endpoints.

title: Myoblast-derived exosomes reduce anticancer drug-induced muscle toxicity via an autocrine pathway.
injury_model: anticancer-drug (oxaliplatin, doxorubicin)-induced myoblast toxicity
ev_source: myoblast-derived exosomes (MDE), serum-starvation conditioned
isolation_method: not fully reported (113 nm mean, exosome markers, EM)
mechanism_chain: myoblast exosomes → myoblast viability and survival (+) under serum starvation
myoblast exosomes → drug-induced cell death (−) at low but not high drug concentration
limitation_zh: 纯体外、效应仅见于低药物浓度；无在体验证。
limitation_en: In vitro only, with an effect seen only at low drug concentrations and no in vivo validation.

title: Enhanced secretion of promyogenic exosomes by quiescent muscle cells.
injury_model: quiescent (G0) vs proliferating vs differentiated muscle cell states
ev_source: quiescent (G0) muscle cells
route_schedule: in vitro treatment of recipient muscle cells
mechanism_chain: quiescence → Kibra (+) → sEV secretion rate (+)
G0-derived exosomes → integrated Wnt reporter activation (+) → myogenic differentiation of proliferating cells (+)
G0 exosomes are preferentially internalised by differentiated myotubes

causal_test.what: Kibra perturbation confirms the secretion-rate role but not the therapeutic effect

limitation_zh: 纯体外；无损伤模型。
limitation_en: In vitro only with no injury model.
notes: Donor-cell-state principle: quiescent muscle stem cells make the most pro-differentiation EVs.

title: Adipose-derived exosomes ameliorate skeletal muscle atrophy via miR-146a-5p/IGF-1R signaling.
injury_model: adipose-specific miR-146a-5p knockout (aKO) mouse muscle atrophy
ev_source: white adipose tissue exosomes of aKO mice (pathogenic, miR-146a-5p deficient)
mechanism_chain: adipose miR-146a-5p deletion → aKO-WAT-exosomes → myotube differentiation (−), atrophy (+)
miR-146a-5p → IGF-1R (+) → PI3K/AKT/mTOR (+) and FoxO3 (−) → muscle protein synthesis (+)
miR-146a-5p mimic co-incubation reverses the aKO-exosome effect

causal_test.what: genetic adipose-specific knockout plus mimic rescue

limitation_zh: EV干预为体外；在体表型来自基因敲除而非EV给药。
limitation_en: The EV intervention is in vitro; the in vivo phenotype comes from the genetic knockout rather than EV delivery.
notes: Complements PMID 40211295: the same miRNA, opposite direction.

title: Human Neuromuscular Junction on a Chip: Impact of Amniotic Fluid Stem Cell Extracellular Vesicles on Muscle Atrophy and NMJ Integrity.
injury_model: dexamethasone-induced atrophy in a human neuromuscular-junction-on-chip (motor neuron/myotube co-culture)
ev_source: amniotic fluid stem cells (AFSC-EV)
route_schedule: applied to muscle and/or motor-neuron compartments of the microfluidic device
mechanism_chain: AFSC-EV → oxidative stress in atrophic myotubes and neurites (−) → NMJ morphological and functional defects (−)
limitation_zh: 体外器官芯片模型，无在体验证；货物未鉴定。
limitation_en: In vitro organ-on-chip model with no in vivo validation and unidentified cargo.

title: Arsenic disrupts extracellular vesicle-mediated signaling in regenerating myofibers.
injury_model: low-dose arsenic (50 nM) exposure during muscle regeneration in a 3D contractile construct
species: mouse primary muscle progenitor cells in 3D construct
ev_source: arsenic-exposed muscle cells and muscle of arsenic-exposed mice (pathogenic EV)
route_schedule: in vitro EV treatment of muscle constructs
mechanism_chain: arsenic → muscle-cell EV signalling disrupted → myofibre diameter (−) and construct strength (−) after injury
EVs from arsenic-exposed mice → construct strength (−) (transferable effect)

causal_test.what: EV transfer recapitulates direct arsenic exposure

limitation_zh: 体外3D模型；货物未鉴定；环境毒素模型与放射损伤相关性有限。
limitation_en: In vitro 3D model with unidentified cargo, and an environmental-toxin model has limited relevance to radiation injury.
notes: Useful precedent: a genotoxic/oxidative stressor makes muscle EVs functionally harmful - conceptually parallel to Rad-EVs.

title: Engineering Bioactive M2 Macrophage-Polarized, Anti-inflammatory, miRNA-Based Liposomes for Functional Muscle Repair: From Exosomal Mechanisms to Biomaterials.
injury_model: muscle injury with inflammation; myoblast-macrophage crosstalk
ev_source: inflammatory myoblast exosomes (pathogenic); therapeutic arm uses antagomiR-224 liposomes, not EVs
route_schedule: in vitro EV transfer; in vivo antagomiR-224 or miR-224-inhibitor liposomes
mechanism_chain: inflammation → myoblast RB/E2F1 (+) → exosomal miR-224 (+) → WNT-9a (−) in macrophages → M2 polarisation (−)
M1 macrophage secretome → myogenic differentiation (−), proliferation (+)
antagomiR-224 or miR-224-inhibitor liposomes in vivo → fibrosis (−), muscle recovery (+)

causal_test.what: antagomiR-224 in vivo; WNT-9a target validation

limitation_zh: 在体治疗用脂质体而非EV，因此EV干预证据仅体外。
limitation_en: The in vivo therapy uses liposomes rather than EVs, so the EV-intervention evidence is in vitro only.
notes: Graded C for the EV edge; the miR-224/WNT-9a module itself is well supported.

title: Physiactisome: A New Nanovesicle Drug Containing Heat Shock Protein 60 for Treating Muscle Wasting and Cachexia.
injury_model: muscle wasting and cachexia (in vitro)
ev_source: Hsp60-overexpressing C2C12 conditioned medium enriched in small and large EVs ('Physiactisome')
route_schedule: in vitro treatment of naive C2C12
mechanism_chain: Physiactisome HSP60 → PGC-1α isoform 1 (+) → mitochondrial biogenesis (+) → muscle atrophy suppression (proposed)

causal_test.what: no in vivo validation

limitation_zh: 纯体外、仅表达终点；为条件培养基富集物而非纯化EV。
limitation_en: In vitro only with an expression endpoint, and the preparation is an enriched conditioned medium rather than purified EVs.

title: Exosomes isolated from the miR-215-modified bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells protect H2O2-induced rat myoblasts via the miR-215/FABP3 pathway.
injury_model: hydrogen peroxide-induced rat myoblast (L6) injury
ev_source: rat BMSC exosomes, with or without miR-215 overexpression
mechanism_chain: miR-215-modified BMSC exosomes → FABP3 (−) → CDKN1A (−), TP53 (−), CCNB1 (+) → viability (+), apoptosis (−)

causal_test.what: dual-luciferase validation of FABP3 as the miR-215 target

limitation_zh: 纯体外，无在体验证；FABP3在骨骼肌损伤中的作用证据薄弱。
limitation_en: In vitro only with no in vivo validation, and the role of FABP3 in skeletal muscle injury is weakly supported.

title: Exosomes derived from inflammatory myoblasts promote M1 polarization and break the balance of myoblast proliferation/differentiation.
injury_model: LPS-induced inflammation of C2C12 myoblasts (acute muscle injury context)
ev_source: inflammatory C2C12 myoblast exosomes (IF-C2C12-Exos, pathogenic)
mechanism_chain: inflammatory myoblast exosomes → macrophage M1 polarisation (+), M2 (−) → inflammatory cytokines (+)
→ myoblast proliferation (+) but fibrogenic/myogenic differentiation (−)
limitation_zh: 纯体外；解释了损伤后炎症迁延的机制，但无治疗性干预。
limitation_en: In vitro only; it explains prolonged post-injury inflammation but provides no therapeutic intervention.

title: Cyclic Hypoxia Conditioning Alters the Content of Myoblast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles and Enhances Their Cell-Protective Functions.
injury_model: cyclic hypoxia-reoxygenation (remote ischemic conditioning mimic)
species: mouse C2C12; in vivo tMCAO (brain, not muscle)
ev_source: C2C12 myoblasts subjected to cyclic hypoxia-reoxygenation (HR-EV)
route_schedule: in vitro treatment; in vivo biodistribution in stroke model
cargo_implicated: shifted miRNA and protein profile after hypoxia-reoxygenation
mechanism_chain: HR-EV → recipient cell viability (+), inflammation (−), endothelial tube formation (+)
HR-EV → accumulation in ischemic brain (+)
limitation_zh: 体外为主，在体终点为脑缺血而非骨骼肌。
limitation_en: Mainly in vitro, and the in vivo endpoint is cerebral ischemia rather than skeletal muscle.

title: Muscle Stem Cell-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Reverse Hydrogen Peroxide-Induced Mitochondrial Dysfunction in Mouse Myotubes.
injury_model: hydrogen peroxide-induced mitochondrial dysfunction in myotubes
ev_source: muscle stem cells (MuSC-EV)
route_schedule: in vitro treatment after oxidative injury
mechanism_chain: MuSC-EV → protein cargo delivered into myotubes within 2 h, partly co-localising with mitochondria → maximal oxygen consumption rate (+) and spare respiratory capacity (+) in damaged myotubes only
limitation_zh: 纯体外；未鉴定具体蛋白货物；对未损伤肌管无效（提示仅修复不扩容）。
limitation_en: In vitro only, the protein cargo is not identified, and there is no effect on undamaged myotubes (repair rather than expansion).
notes: Cited by the radiation paper (PMID 40835994) as mechanistic support.

title: Placenta-derived mesenchymal stromal cells and their exosomes exert therapeutic effects in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
injury_model: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (mdx mice; DMD patient myoblasts)
ev_source: placenta-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (PL-MSC) and their exosomes
route_schedule: intramuscular transplantation (cells); exosome/conditioned-medium treatment in vitro
mechanism_chain: PL-MSC exosomal miR-29c → fibrogenic gene expression (−) in DMD myoblasts; myoblast differentiation (+); utrophin (+)
PL-MSC → TGF-β (−) → diaphragm and cardiac fibrosis (−); inflammation (−); creatine kinase (−)

causal_test.what: quantitative miR-29c reporter demonstrates exosomal transfer

limitation_zh: 在体给药为细胞而非外泌体，外泌体效应仅在体外证明；剂量未报告。
limitation_en: The in vivo intervention was cells rather than exosomes; exosome effects were shown in vitro only, and dose is unreported.
notes: Graded C because the EV intervention itself is in vitro only.

title: Extracellular Vesicles Released by Oxidatively Injured or Intact C2C12 Myotubes Promote Distinct Responses Converging toward Myogenesis.
injury_model: mild oxidative stress (H2O2) in C2C12 myotubes
ev_source: C2C12 myotubes, oxidatively challenged (H2O2-EV) vs intact
route_schedule: in vitro treatment of myoblasts and macrophages
cargo_implicated: nucleic acid cargo, mainly DNA (increased in H2O2-EV)
mechanism_chain: H2O2-EV → recipient myoblast PCNA (+) → proliferation (+); myotube diameter (−), myogenin (−), MyHC (−)
intact myotube EV → slight pro-differentiation effect
H2O2-EV → macrophage IL-6 (+)
limitation_zh: 纯体外；EV货物以DNA增加为主，功能归因不明确。
limitation_en: In vitro only, and with mainly increased DNA cargo the functional attribution is unclear.
notes: Supports a damage-state-dependent switch between proliferative and differentiative EV signals.
